articles.title: Elon Musk’s xAI used child porn to train Grok models, lawsuit says
articles.text:
xAI has now been accused of training Grok on child sex abuse materials (CSAM), as regulators and courts continue to probe how far the problem goes, and some Grok users have been arrested.
In a complaint filed on Wednesday, a plaintiff known as Jane Doe explained that she was preschool-age in the early 2000s when adult men repeatedly raped her to create CSAM to sell to pedophiles online. Since then, Doe’s images have been hashed by groups like the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) and the Canadian Centre for Child Protection (CCCP).
For her safety, Doe has opted to receive alerts from the US Department of Justice Victim Notification System any time she may be a victim in a new criminal investigation. Although she has received countless alerts, she was shocked when the CCCP notified her that it had identified AI-generated CSAM on xAI that depicted her. This re-traumatized Doe, whose complaint alleged that messages were found on online forums “between offenders chatting about creating AI generated CSAM of Plaintiff and other similarly situated known, legacy, victims of CSAM.”
Now, Doe fears that xAI has not only made it easier to make more violative images of the most distressing time in her life, but also that xAI allegedly has stored the images that Grok generates and uses those outputs to further train Grok. Because of this, she believes that Grok has been trained on both the initial set of images that have haunted her for more than 20 years and the more recent AI-generated ones.

articles.title: Esta es la primera batería cuántica funcional: cómo es el invento que desafía la física tradicional
articles.text:
Una batería cuántica que se carga más rápido cuanto más grande es: ese es el objetivo que persigue el investigador James Quach, que dirige una propuesta que desafía una idea básica del mundo cotidiano.
En general, cuanto mayor es una batería, más tiempo tarda en cargarse: por eso puede llevar horas recargar una computadora portátil y, en el caso de un vehículo eléctrico, toda una noche.
PUBLICIDAD
En cambio, en el terreno de la infobae.com/tecno/2026/06/06/investigador-del-mit-predice-que-las-computadoras-cuanticas-seran-utiles-para-la-humanidad-en-menos-de-10-anos, la ciencia que estudia la materia a escala atómica y subatómica, Quach sostiene que esa lógica puede invertirse, según BBC.
Su equipo presentó en marzo de 2026 lo que describen como el primer prototipo funcional de batería cuántica: un dispositivo experimental que, en determinadas condiciones, puede absorber energía más rápido a medida que se le suman más “unidades” activas.
PUBLICIDAD
La apuesta de fondo es resolver un límite práctico: no solo almacenar energía, sino entregarla con mayor velocidad y control.
Esa promesa, si se confirma y se vuelve utilizable fuera del laboratorio, podría impactar primero en la computación cuántica, que contribuye, por ejemplo, al desarrollo rápido de medicamentos.
PUBLICIDAD
El proyecto es liderado por CSIRO (Organización de Investigación Científica e Industrial del Commonwealth) en colaboración con la Universidad de Melbourne y RMIT.
Para qué sirve una batería cuántica
Una batería cuántica sirve para entregar energía más rápido y con mayor control que una batería convencional, gracias a efectos de la mecánica cuántica.
La idea no apunta tanto a almacenar una enorme cantidad de energía, sino a poder cargar y descargar de una manera distinta, útil cuando un sistema necesita energía en pulsos muy rápidos o con una administración extremadamente precisa.
PUBLICIDAD
En una batería convencional, en cambio, la energía se obtiene mediante reacciones electroquímicas: ese mecanismo sostiene el flujo de enormes cantidades de electrones a través del dispositivo que se alimenta. Aunque la tecnología mejoró mucho, todavía depende de procesos investigados desde hace más de dos siglos.
La batería cuántica propone otra vía: aprovechar efectos cuánticos en lugar de reacciones químicas.
De acuerdo con el medio británico, Dario Ferraro, profesor asociado de Física en la Universidad de Génova (Italia), lo resume con una idea clave: el punto no es guardar una enorme cantidad de energía, sino entregarla más rápido y con mayor control.
PUBLICIDAD
En qué va el desarrollo de la batería cuántica
El desarrollo de la batería cuántica de James Quach está hoy en una etapa de prototipo funcional: su equipo ya mostró que el sistema puede cargarse a velocidades extremas y, más recientemente, que es posible extraer una corriente eléctrica, un paso clave para que la energía no quede solo dentro del experimento, sino que pueda usarse.
El enfoque se basa en una microcavidad óptica, un montaje donde dos espejos diminutos se ubican a 100 nanómetros de distancia (un grosor alrededor de mil veces menor que un cabello humano).
PUBLICIDAD
En ese espacio, el equipo coloca moléculas de un tinte orgánico y las excita con un láser. Con ese método, la luz y las moléculas pueden acoplarse con fuerza y formar estados híbridos de luz y materia, lo que potencia la absorción y el almacenamiento de energía mediante un fenómeno llamado superabsorción.
Ese mecanismo explica el rasgo más llamativo del prototipo: en lugar de comportarse como “unidades” independientes —como suele asumirse en física clásica—, las moléculas pueden actuar en conjunto.
PUBLICIDAD
Así, la tasa de absorción aumenta con el número de moléculas: cuantas más participan, más rápido se carga el sistema.
Según los resultados descriptos, el prototipo llegó a cargarse en femtosegundos (una cuatrillonésima de segundo) y pudo conservar la energía por nanosegundos, un lapso aproximadamente seis órdenes de magnitud mayor.
PUBLICIDAD
Quach y su equipo mostraron este logro en 2022 y, en marzo de 2026, sumaron un avance relevante: lograron extraer una corriente eléctrica del prototipo.
Aun así, el dispositivo está lejos de reemplazar una batería convencional. La limitación más concreta es que, por ahora, solo retiene una cantidad muy pequeña de energía (del orden de “unos pocos miles de millones de electronvolts”) durante nanosegundos. Para alimentar dispositivos comunes, haría falta almacenar mucho más y por mucho más tiempo.
Quach asegura que ya avanzó en un diseño nuevo y que trabaja en un artículo científico para publicar esos resultados.
Dario Ferraro advierte que las interacciones con el entorno pueden degradar los efectos cuánticos y limitar rendimiento y escalabilidad.

articles.title: How To Watch the English Premier League on Fubo in Canada
articles.text:
Canadian soccer (or football) fans rejoice, as the English Premier League is back and has just played through its first weekend of the regular season. If you’re looking to catch matches from one of the top leagues in the world, I’ll show you how to watch it.
Before we get into it, though, let’s add some context. The 2026-2027 Premier League season started on August 21, with the final games set to be played on May 30, 2027. The season will consist of 33 weekends and five midweek match rounds and is designed to avoid clashes with domestic and UEFA club competition dates.
Now, here is how to catch all of the action.
How to watch
The good news is you don’t need to subscribe to a bunch of different streaming services in order to access every Premier League match.
In Canada, Fubo is the exclusive home for Premier League matches. Alongside that, if you want to catch matches from other top leagues around the globe (Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Concacaf, Canadian Premier League), you can do so directly through the service.
Now, Fubo isn’t free. You do have to get a subscription, and there are some tiers involved as well. To access the Premier League and Serie A, you need to subscribe to the service’s mid-tier “Sports Monthly” package, which also gives you access to 71 channels (compared to 51).
Notably, Fubo does use channels. Most of them are sports-related, but outside of football/soccer, you get access to MLB TV, NBA TV Canada, Flo Hockey, Flo Racing, Fox Racing, ONE Championship, the World Poker Tour, and the Big Ten Network. You also get access to CHCH, so if you’re in the Hamilton, Halton, or Niagara regions, you can get your local news channel bundled with all of your sports channels.
Anywho, here are the Premier League-eligible tiers that you can subscribe to:
Sports
- Monthly – $31.49
- Quarterly (billed every three months) – $44.97 (regular: $83.97)
- Annual (billed every 12 months) – $231 (regular: $293.99)
Sports Pro
- Monthly – $39.99 (regular $44.99)
- Quarterly – $134.97 (regular $149.97)
- Annual – $449.93
Note that the discounted rates are only for the first stretch of subscription (e.g. the first three months on a quarterly subscription), and then prices jump back up to the regular amount.

articles.title: Überraschung im Marsmantel: Sonden-Daten offenbaren extreme thermische Anomalie
articles.text:
Geheimnis der Mars-Krater: Neue Methode zeigt Zweiteilung im Planeteninneren
Ein Team von Planetenforscher:innen hat tief unter der Marsoberfläche eine ausgedehnte thermische Abweichung entdeckt. Der Mantel des Planeten ist in der südlichen Hemisphäre um 200 bis 400 Grad Celsius heißer als in der nördlichen Hälfte, wie in einer jüngst im Wissenschaftsmagazin Nature veröffentlichten Studie zu lesen ist.
Diese Hitzeschicht liefert ein neues Erklärungsmodell für die sogenannte Mars-Dichotomie. Dabei handelt es sich um den Umstand, dass der Norden des Planeten aus flachen Ebenen besteht, während der Süden von hochgelegenen Kraterlandschaften geprägt ist.
Gezeitentomografie wertet Tracking-Daten der NASA aus
Um in das Innere des Planeten zu blicken, nutzte das Team um den Planetenforscher Nick Wagner von der US-amerikanischen Brown University im Bundesstaat Rhode Island einen als Gezeitentomografie bekannten Ansatz. Die Wissenschaftler:innen analysierten dafür die Tracking-Daten der drei Raumsonden Mars Global Surveyor, Mars Odyssey und Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter der US-Raumfahrtbehörde Nasa aus den vergangenen 16 Jahren.
Dabei maßen sie die minimalen gravitativen Abweichungen des Mars während seiner Umlaufbahn um die Sonne. Die resultierenden Daten offenbarten Asymmetrien, die sich um bis zu 300 Prozent von den Werten unterscheiden, die bei einem völlig kugelsymmetrischen Planeten zu erwarten wären.
Ursachen der Temperaturunterschiede im Marsmantel
Die genaue Ursache für diese thermische Asymmetrie ist wissenschaftlich noch nicht abschließend geklärt. Das Team vermutet, dass heutige Konvektionsströme im Mantel oder die isolierende Wirkung der dicken südlichen Kruste über Milliarden von Jahren hinweg für den enormen Temperaturunterschied verantwortlich sein könnten.
Nick Wagner erklärte gegenüber 404 Media, dass das Marsinnere noch immer weitgehend unbekannt sei. „Diese Studie liefert keine Antwort auf die Frage nach dem Ursprung der Dichotomie, fügt aber einen weiteren Beweis hinzu, um herauszufinden, was unter der Marskruste tatsächlich vor sich geht“, konstatiert der Planetenforscher.
Einfluss von Eisen auf den südlichen Marsmantel
Neben der reinen Temperaturabweichung zogen die Forscher:innen auch kompositorische Unterschiede als Erklärung für die Messdaten heran. Die Modellierungen lassen den Schluss zu, dass der Mantel unter den südlichen Hochebenen eine bis zu fünfprozentige Anreicherung mit Eisen aufweisen könnte.
Eine solche Veränderung in der Zusammensetzung könnte das Resultat von großflächigen, historischen Schmelzprozessen sein. Wenn Magma aufsteigt und in der dicken südlichen Kruste stecken bleibt, entzieht das dem umliegenden Mantel bestimmte Elemente, was die beobachteten Schwankungen im Datenmaterial ebenfalls stützen würde.
Thermische Faktoren für das planetare Magnetfeld
Dieser Aufstieg von Magma könnte zudem einen Erklärungsansatz für die starke Restmagnetisierung der südlichen Hemisphäre liefern. Die Hitze aus dem Planeteninneren könnte die darüberliegende Kruste in der Frühphase des Mars punktuell stark erhitzt haben.
Dieser Aufstieg von Magma könnte zudem einen Erklärungsansatz für die starke Restmagnetisierung der südlichen Hemisphäre liefern. Die Hitze aus dem Planeteninneren dürfte die darüberliegende Kruste in der Frühphase des Mars punktuell stark erhitzt haben. Als das Gestein anschließend abkühlte, während das planetare Magnetfeld noch aktiv war, wurde die magnetische Signatur dauerhaft in den Hochebenen konserviert. Diese These erfordert zwar weitere Untersuchungen, verdeutlicht jedoch die enge Verzahnung von thermischen Prozessen, Geologie und planetarer Geschichte.
Geodynamik entscheidet über potenzielles Leben
Die Gezeitentomografie kam bereits bei der Erforschung von Erde und Mond zum Einsatz, wurde nun aber zum ersten Mal erfolgreich für den Mars angewendet. Die Methode erlaubt es Forscher:innen, das Innere von Himmelskörpern aus der Ferne zu untersuchen, ohne kostspielige Landemissionen durchführen zu müssen.
Das genaue Verständnis der inneren Dynamik des Mars ist ein notwendiger Baustein, um seine frühere Habitabilität zu beurteilen. Vor etwa vier Milliarden Jahren bot die Oberfläche mit Flüssen und Seen theoretisch Bedingungen, die jenen der frühen Erde stark ähnelten.
Schwächen in der Modellrechnung bleiben bestehen
Trotz der präzisen Daten aus 16 Jahren Satellitenbeobachtung weisen die Autor:innen der Studie darauf hin, dass die Berechnungen durch atmosphärische Variablen stark beeinflusst werden können. Die saisonale Kondensation von Kohlendioxid an den Polkappen erfordert komplexe Korrekturen in den Modellen, was in der Praxis immer eine Fehlerquelle darstellt.
Letztlich muss das durch die Studie gezeichnete Bild des Marsinneren durch weitere seismische Analysen auf der Oberfläche validiert werden. Bis dahin bleiben die thermischen Vorgänge tief im Marsmantel ein Forschungsgegenstand, der vorwiegend auf mathematischen Näherungswerten und Fernerkundungsdaten basiert.

articles.title: Lo nuevo de Android impedirá que las apps se acaben la memoria RAM de tu móvil
articles.text:
Google ha tomado una estrategia necesaria para combatir la crisis de memoria provocada por la IA. La compañía anunció nuevas reglas para que las apps de Android no consuman tanta memoria. Los desarrolladores tendrán que optimizar sus aplicaciones para que los móviles con poca RAM puedan ejecutarlas sin problemas.
La compañía mencionó que la industria de los móviles atraviesa restricciones de suministro de hardware que alteran la memoria disponible en los dispositivos. Si volvemos en el tiempo, hace poco más de un año era común pensar que los móviles de nueva generación llegarían con más RAM. Era un paso lógico, pero la escasez de memoria provocada por la IA reconfiguró la estrategia de muchos fabricantes, quienes ahora lanzan modelos con la misma cantidad de RAM que el año pasado, o menos.
El gigante tecnológico anunció nuevos requisitos de calidad para las apps que se publican en la Play Store, los cuales se enfocan en reducir el consumo de memoria. El primero introduce umbrales de rendimiento en áreas como el uso dinámico de memoria y bitmaps. Google evaluará el gasto según el estado de la app, ya sea en uso o en segundo plano, y según la categoría de rendimiento de cada dispositivo.
En el caso de los bitmaps, Google vigilará el uso de las imágenes que las apps cargan en la memoria mientras están en primer plano. Esto representa un problema si las imágenes se mantienen almacenadas durante mucho tiempo en estados no visibles, por ejemplo, cuando la app pasa a segundo plano o queda en caché. La tecnológica buscará evitar este consumo de ahora en adelante.
Google no quiere que las apps se acaben la poca RAM que le queda a los móviles
Por último, Google añadió un requisito de optimización del código DEX, el cual exige que las apps publicadas en la Play Store alcancen (al menos) un 25% de cobertura combinada en optimización, reducción y ofuscación. Un paquete de aplicación bien optimizado consume menos memoria, arranca más rápido y mejora el rendimiento durante su ejecución.
Los nuevos requisitos entran en vigor a partir de ahora, aunque los desarrolladores tendrán hasta febrero de 2027 para adaptar sus aplicaciones. Para cumplir con estos nuevos límites, Google lanzó una suite de herramientas de diagnóstico que avisarán cuando una app supere los umbrales establecidos. La compañía confirmó que lanzará funciones adicionales a futuro, como un sistema que impedirá que las aplicaciones consuman más memoria de la que tienen asignada en el dispositivo.
Sumado a los ajustes en la memoria, Google exigirá que todas las apps con inicio de sesión cumplan el requisito de Zero Tap Sign-In. Esta norma obliga a que el estado de sesión del usuario se restaure automáticamente al cambiar de un dispositivo Android a otro. Los desarrolladores deberán actualizar sus aplicaciones antes de abril de 2027 si quieren mantenerlas en la Play Store.
“Mantener un ecosistema Android saludable es un compromiso compartido en el que cada aplicación y juego tiene un papel que desempeñar”, dijo la empresa.

articles.title: Google's AI Mode can now track flight prices, help book hotels, and more | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Google is adding new ways for users to plan and book trips through AI Mode, its conversational search experience, the company announced on Thursday. Users will now be able to ask AI Mode to track flight prices, book hotels, and see the cost of flights and hotels in points or miles.
The updates indicate that Google is looking to position AI Mode as an AI travel agent of sorts, as it’s moving beyond simply helping users find information to actually handling parts of the trip-planning and booking process itself.
Users can now describe to AI Mode when and where they want to fly, and the tool will display the best options available with the latest prices from more than 300 airlines and travel sites. If they’re ready to book, they can go ahead and build their itinerary in AI Mode. If they want to wait and see if prices drop, they can ask something like “track these flight prices for me.”
They’ll then get an email if prices change for the destination and dates they entered. Flight price tracking in AI Mode is now available in more than 180 countries.
As for hotel booking, users will be able to discover and book their next hotel through a conversation with AI Mode. Users can tell AI Mode about their upcoming trip and their hotel preferences to get a list of options alongside reviews and key factors.
Once they’ve found a hotel they like, they can ask AI Mode to help complete the booking. Then they need to select the “Continue on Google” option that will appear alongside Google’s integrated partners, which includes hotel chains and travel sites.
From there, they can choose their room, review details such as the cancellation policy, and complete the booking with Google Pay. The tech giant notes that the hotel or booking platform will handle the booking and any customer service.
Hotel booking in AI Mode has started rolling out in the U.S. in English and will be available over the coming weeks with offerings from Booking.com, Choice Hotels International, Expedia, Hilton, Hotels.com, IHG Hotels & Resorts, Marriott International, Priceline, Trip.com, and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts.
Google also announced that AI Mode can now display the cost in points or miles for flights and hotels by asking something like “I want to travel from Atlanta to Miami using my AA miles. Help me find some options for nonstop flights departing Oct 9 and returning on Oct 12”.
Users will then see how many miles they need to book matching flights. The update is now available globally.

articles.title: NewPower Worldwide Expands Credit Facility to $750 Million to Support Global Growth and Customer Demand - EE Times
articles.text:
NASHUA, New Hampshire – NewPower Worldwide, one of the electronics industry’s fastest-growing distributors, today announced it has expanded its committed credit facility to $750 million, further enhancing its ability to invest in inventory, support customer growth, and capitalize on opportunities across the global supply chain.
The increase follows a period of exceptional growth for NewPower Worldwide. Since its founding in 2014, the company has rapidly expanded its global footprint, growing to 14 offices across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, with $5 billion in annual sales, and managing more than $1 billion in inventory worldwide. The expanded facility provides additional financial capacity to support continued growth and evolving customer requirements.
In today’s rapidly changing supply chain environment, financial strength and access to capital play a critical role in securing inventory and maintaining continuity of supply. The expanded facility enhances NewPower’s ability to purchase strategically, support large-scale customer requirements, and provide greater flexibility around inventory and delivery programs.
“Our customers rely on NewPower to solve supply chain challenges quickly and at scale,” said Carleton Dufoe, Chief Executive Officer of NewPower Worldwide. “Expanding our credit facility to $750 million gives us additional capacity to secure inventory, support larger strategic programs, and respond faster when opportunities arise across the market. It further strengthens our ability to deliver solutions that help customers succeed in any market environment.”
The expanded facility strengthens NewPower’s ability to support larger and more complex customer programs while increasing the volume and scale of transactions the company can execute globally. By increasing its purchasing capacity, NewPower is better positioned to secure strategic inventory, capitalize on market opportunities, and deliver supply solutions to customers with greater speed, flexibility, and scale.
“Our expanded partnership with NewPower reflects our confidence in the company as it executes on behalf of its clients,” said Jason Upham, Senior Vice President at Citizens. “Our banking team led an increased credit facility designed to support NewPower’s goals and growth objectives.”
The expanded facility reflects NewPower’s continued financial strength and enhances its ability to convert market opportunities into tangible supply solutions for customers worldwide. Combined with the company’s global sourcing network and supply chain expertise, the added capacity positions NewPower to execute larger programs, secure critical inventory, and help customers respond to changing market conditions with speed, flexibility, and confidence.
About NewPower Worldwide
NewPower Worldwide is a leading independent distributor of electronic components and finished goods, serving OEMs, EMS providers, and supply chain partners worldwide. Privately owned and headquartered in Nashua, New Hampshire, the company is recognized for its advanced sourcing technology, global reach, and commitment to solving complex supply chain challenges.

articles.title: Startup news and updates: Daily roundup (August 27, 2026)
articles.text:
Startup news and updates: Daily roundup (August 27, 2026)
YourStory presents the daily news roundup from the Indian startup ecosystem and beyond. Here's the roundup for Thursday, August 27, 2026.
From Bill Gates' call for taxing AI and reserving jobs for humans to Deepinder Goyal-backed Temple's acquisition of Longevous, YourStory brings you today’s headlines with the latest developments across sectors.
Featured stories
Bill Gates calls for taxing AI, reserving some jobs for humans
Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates has called for governments to take concrete steps to manage the upheaval caused by artificial intelligence, saying that they should tax AI and robots, strengthen support for displaced workers and deliberately set aside some jobs for humans. His proposals come as AI advances rapidly and begins to take on tasks once considered dependent on human judgement. Gates warns that governments are not preparing quickly enough for a technology that could reshape employment, public services, security and everyday life.
Read more
SugarStrings.ai uses simple cheek swabs to identify thousands of genetic disorders
Bengaluru-based healthtech startup SugarStrings.ai has developed a non-invasive DNA test that screens users for more than 7,442 genetic disorders, and aims to make genetic testing more accessible and privacy-focused.
Latest news
Deepinder Goyal’s wearable startup Temple acquires London-based Longevous
Deepinder Goyal-backed Temple has acquired evidence-based Longevous as it builds its clinical and scientific capabilities ahead of its launch. As part of the acquisition, London-headquartered Longevous founders Dr Robert Mohr and Dr Avi Roy, along with their team, will join Temple full-time.
Funding news
Logistics tech startup TrucksUp raises $8.2M in growth funding
Gurugram-based logistics technology platform TrucksUp has raised $8.2 million in funding from institutions, family offices along with participation from the Co-founders, Sarthak Shah Elwadhi and Aviraj Singh Chadha.
Astrology platform InstaAstro raises $12M in Series A round
InstaAstro, a Noida-based online astrology platform, has raised $12 million in a Series A round led by Singularity AMC and Artha Venture Fund, with participation from its founders. InstaAstro will use the funding to build AI-led solutions, including sentiment analysis to help astrologers deliver more contextual consultations and multilingual support to improve the consultation experience across languages. It also plans to expand its pooja seva and spiritual commerce businesses.
InspeCity inches closer to orbit with Rs 100 Cr funding boost
Spacetech startup InspeCity has raised Rs 100 crore in a pre-Series A round of funding led by Speciale Invest, Ashish Kacholia, Antler India, Manish Gandhi, Shastra VC, and others.
Biryani Bees raises $1M from Vivek Oberoi Family office
Biryani Bees, a biryani and Indian meals brand, has raised $1 million from the Vivek Oberoi Family Office to accelerate its expansion across India’s Tier II markets. The company currently operates three outlets in Uttar Pradesh and plans to expand to 10 outlets across Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and other high-potential Tier II markets.
The funding will initially support the expansion to 10 outlets, strengthen central kitchen infrastructure, build the operating team and establish a repeatable expansion model. Biryani Bees said the investment will help it take its existing business model into new markets while strengthening the infrastructure required to scale across multiple states. Its long-term ambition is to build a national network offering standardised, affordable and quality daily meals.
OORJAA raises Rs 9.7 Cr in Series A funding
Technology-led logistics platform OORJAA has raised Rs 9.7 crore in a Series A round led by Equentis Angel Fund, with participation from Inflection Point Ventures. The company will deploy the capital towards technology and product development, scaling its proprietary AI/SaaS logistics stack Datashastra, and strengthening its control-tower and automation capabilities.
OORJAA will also expand its mid-mile and last-mile network across new cities and categories, take Datashastra into international markets beginning with the GCC, and hire talent across technology, operations and enterprise sales.
The company operates an asset-light, full-stack model combining hubs, fleet and manpower with its technology platform. It currently moves more than three million products and 50,000 last-mile orders daily across over 200 cities.
Edgeverse raises Rs 3 crore from GVFL
GVFL has invested Rs 3 crore in Edgeverse India, a deep-tech startup developing edge AI-based perception technology for mobility and other real-world applications. The investment will support Edgeverse's next phase of growth, including the development of India-specific road intelligence, camera and radar technology, and the commercialisation of its AI-powered perception solutions. Edgeverse previously received Rs 1.85 crore in seed funding from ARTPARK and was selected as one of the winners of the NASSCOM Mobility Innovation Challenge 2025.
Founded in 2023 by Arindam Ghosh, Subrata Debnath and Navaneeth A, Edgeverse is building a hardware-agnostic perception stack that combines edge AI with sensors such as cameras and radar. The technology is designed to help original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and Tier-I suppliers deploy advanced safety and perception capabilities across vehicles.
Velaan Mart raises Rs 1.26 Cr in funding
Velaan Mart Agritech has raised Rs 1.26 crore in funding from Next Bharat Ventures. This agritech startup is building an organised farm-to-institution supply chain designed to improve market access for farmers while providing fresh and quality-assured produce to institutional and commercial buyers.
The company currently operates across Tiruchirappalli, Thanjavur, Pudukkottai and Karaikudi, serving colleges, hostels, restaurants and other institutional customers through its integrated procurement and distribution network. Existing agricultural supply chain has several inefficiencies and Velaan Mart aims to address this gap by creating a direct connection between farmers and bulk buyers.
The company sources fresh produce closer to the point of origin and manages procurement, quality checks, processing, storage and distribution through an integrated supply chain. Its model is focused on reducing unnecessary intermediaries while creating greater transparency around pricing, quality and sourcing.
Other news
Swiggy’s Food on Train grows 12x in two years
Swiggy’s Food on Train service has grown 12-fold between August 2024 and August 2026, with adoption in Tier-2 and Tier-3 markets growing twice as fast as in metropolitan cities. The service has expanded to 201 railway stations, up from 66 in 2024.
Swiggy has also introduced two features to make train-food ordering easier. ‘Search by Train’ allows users to enter their train number or name to see food options mapped to their route and schedule. The ‘99 Store Widget’ provides passengers with quick access to budget-friendly meals.
Swiggy said food preferences among train travellers are also changing, with demand rising for lassi, buttermilk and mojitos, while traditional meals such as thalis account for more than 65% of orders. Sweet orders have increased 110%, led by rasgullas.
Flipkart Ads launches Saarthi for sellers and brands
Flipkart has launched Saarthi, an Ads Partner Program designed to provide sellers and brands with professional advertising support at zero cost. The programme combines an AI-powered campaign tool with a network of certified agency partners offering hands-on campaign management. Flipkart said sellers have identified campaign complexity, uncertainty over where to begin and difficulty understanding campaign performance as key challenges.
Saarthi aims to address these issues by helping businesses navigate digital advertising and improve campaign effectiveness. Agencies such as Accenture and Dentsu have been integrated into Flipkart’s ad-tech ecosystem and can guide sellers from campaign creation to sustained growth. Sellers and brands will be matched with agency partners based on their business stage, growth objectives and advertising readiness. The programme also offers campaign optimisation, knowledge and guidance.
T-Hub, Honda launch Innovation Challenge 2.0
T-Hub and Honda Digital Innovation India have partnered to launch Honda Innovation Challenge 2.0, a year-long programme aimed at co-building digital mobility and customer experience solutions with Indian startups. The programme features three new challenges and total funding of up to Rs 4.8 crore. Each challenge will select four startups eligible for up to Rs 40 lakh to develop proof-of-concept projects with Honda teams, significantly higher than the Rs 10 lakh available under the first challenge.
Selected startups will work directly with Honda engineering and business teams during a 12-week sprint and gain access to testing environments, operational insights and deployment support. Successful PoCs can progress to pilots and potentially be integrated into Honda products or services. The programme is open to startups across India.
Rodic Consultants partners with Nasscom for InfraAI Innovation challenge
Rodic Consultants, one of India's leading infrastructure and engineering consultancies, has partnered with Nasscom to launch the Rodic InfraAI Innovation Challenge, a first-of-its-kind initiative aimed at accelerating the adoption of artificial intelligence across India's infrastructure and strategic sectors. Supported by Startup India through outreach to DPIIT-recognised startups, the initiative seeks to bring together the country's rapidly expanding AI and deep-tech ecosystem to develop scalable, deployment-ready solutions for some of India's most pressing infrastructure challenges.
The Innovation Challenge marks the first milestone in a broader strategic partnership between Rodic Consultants and Nasscom to discover, nurture and deploy frontier AI technologies across live infrastructure projects in India. By combining Rodic’s extensive domain expertise, real-world project environments and infrastructure problem statements with Nasscom’s innovation ecosystem, while leveraging Startup India’s outreach to DPIIT-recognised startups.
VenturEdu launches zero-fee Emerging Founders Program
VenturEdu has launched the Emerging Founders Program, a zero-fee residential venture-building initiative for aspiring entrepreneurs aged 18 to 28. The programme is open to solo founders and teams of up to four members, with no previous startup experience required. Selected teams attending a two-day bootcamp in Gurgaon in September will be eligible for a stipend of up to Rs 50,000 per team, along with travel reimbursement of up to Rs 5,000.
There will be no programme fee or equity dilution. Twenty-five founders will subsequently be selected for a two-month residency from October 1 to November 30. They will receive mentorship and work on validating ideas, developing products and building business models. The top five startups will gain direct entry into the Fibonacci X accelerator.
Veranda K-12 expands AVINYA innovation challenge
Veranda K-12, a Veranda Learning enterprise, has announced the third season of AVINYA: An Innovation Hub, its flagship innovation challenge for school students. The programme encourages students to identify real-world problems and develop solutions aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.
After attracting more than 300 schools and 800 ideas in its first two editions, the 2026–27 edition will expand to over 100 cities and towns and reach more than one lakh students. Students from Grades 8 to 12 can participate. Online submissions will be followed by a presentation round, with 50–60 ideas shortlisted and the top 15 teams advancing to the national finale at IIIT Bengaluru on December 4–5, 2026. The finalists will receive mentorship and innovation training, while the top three ideas will receive special recognition.
LTM opens global delivery & AI centre in Kolkata
LTM has inaugurated a global delivery and AI competency centre in Kolkata, reinforcing the L&T Group’s long-term commitment to West Bengal as a technology and innovation hub. The facility is expected to support LTM’s growing global delivery capabilities and AI ambitions while creating opportunities for skilled professionals in West Bengal and neighbouring states.
Kolkata’s educational ecosystem, talent pool and expanding digital infrastructure were highlighted as key factors behind the company’s India growth strategy. The centre will serve as a hub for collaboration, innovation and delivery excellence, enabling LTM to support clients globally while contributing to the state’s economic development. The company said the new facility also strengthens its nationwide delivery network and reflects its continued investment in regional centres, digital infrastructure and employee experience.
Pensionbazaar launches Wealth 360 portfolio tracker
Pensionbazaar has launched Wealth 360, a unified portfolio tracking platform designed to give users a consolidated view of their investments and savings. With user consent, the platform brings together bank accounts, fixed deposits, mutual funds, stocks and the National Pension System in one dashboard.
Pensionbazaar said Indian consumers increasingly manage savings across multiple products and institutions, making it difficult to track overall wealth, returns, asset allocation and progress towards financial goals. Wealth 360 aims to address this fragmentation by providing a single view of a user’s financial portfolio.
Vishwajeet Goel, Head of Pensionbazaar, said investors do not need more products but “one clear view” of everything they have built. The platform also integrates retirement savings with everyday investments to provide a broader view of financial planning.
AMU targets Rs 400 Cr EV financing AUM by 2027
Accelerated Money for Upliftment (AMU), an electric vehicle financing company, is targeting EV financing assets under management (AUM) of Rs 400 crore by March 2027 and plans to increase this to Rs 600 crore by March 2028. The company expects its EV financing business to record 35–40% growth in disbursements, driven primarily by electric commercial vehicles. Commercial EVs currently account for 100% of AMU’s EV financing portfolio, reflecting its focus on the commercial mobility segment.
The company’s EV financing portfolio has recorded a CAGR of around 38%. AMU currently operates across Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, West Bengal, Bihar and Haryana, financing electric commercial vehicles used for passenger and cargo mobility. It expects demand to remain supported by the lower operating costs and improving economics of electric mobility.
Binance launches Agent OS for AI-powered applications
Crypto exchange Binance has introduced Agent OS, a developer platform designed to provide standardised access for AI applications to Binance’s trading, market data, wallet, payment and on-chain capabilities. Built under Binance Intelligence, the initiative aims to provide AI builders, fintech developers and quantitative trading teams with a controlled foundation for developing applications and agents that interact with financial infrastructure.
Agent OS supports ready-made integrations as well as users’ own AI agents. Through tools including ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, users can authorise agents to access market data, view account information and conduct supported trading activities, subject to configured permissions and limits. Binance said users can also assign individual agents to dedicated subaccounts, allowing them to segregate funds and trading activity.
NABARD, NaBFID sign MoU on rural infrastructure financing
The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) and the National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) have signed a memorandum of understanding to strengthen collaboration in financing infrastructure projects with significant rural impact. The partnership combines NABARD’s expertise in rural and agricultural infrastructure with NaBFID’s specialised infrastructure financing capabilities.
Under the agreement, the institutions will explore joint financing, knowledge sharing and innovative financing solutions aimed at expanding access to long-term and competitively priced funding for projects that can strengthen rural infrastructure and value chains. Their collaboration will cover project identification, appraisal, due diligence, credit structuring, pricing and joint monitoring. They will also work on project structuring, financial modelling and debt syndication, alongside joint capacity-building initiatives drawing on the training institutions of both organisations.
Tulu Health launches Longevity OS
AI-native healthcare company Tulu Health has launched Longevity OS, a platform designed to convert fragmented clinical, laboratory, wearable and patient engagement data into daily actions for improving patient retention, engagement and clinic revenue. The company has also announced plans to expand its presence in the US. Tulu Health said its AI systems have already automated more than 100,000 healthcare operational tasks, with year-on-year growth exceeding 90%.
Longevity OS creates a unified patient twin and uses AI Voice, SMS and other channels to identify patients who may be at risk of disengagement before renewal. The company said longevity and wellness clinics often collect large volumes of patient data but lack tools to turn that information into timely interventions. The new platform aims to bridge that gap by translating data into actionable insights.
IndiaFirst Life selects Salesforce Agentforce
IndiaFirst Life Insurance Company, a Bank of Baroda subsidiary, has selected Salesforce’s Agentforce to advance its enterprise-wide artificial intelligence transformation. The insurer plans to embed AI agents into critical processes to improve sales, streamline operations and enhance customer experience. The initiative builds on IndiaFirst Life’s unified Salesforce platform, which supports the insurance journey from lead generation through claims settlement.
The company serves customers across more than 90% of India’s pin codes and continues to expand its distribution network. IndiaFirst Life will deploy Agentforce across three priority areas: new business underwriting, customer service and claims processing. Salesforce said the initiative represents the next phase of its collaboration with the insurer and supports IndiaFirst Life’s ambition to develop a more intelligent and customer-centric life insurance experience through greater use of AI across key business processes.
GSM VinFast, ARC Electric partner for corporate EV mobility
GSM VinFast has partnered with ARC Electric, a B2B electric mobility platform, to strengthen electric vehicle-based corporate mobility services. Under the partnership, ARC Electric will facilitate electric cab services for ad-hoc travel, airport transfers and employee transportation services, initially across Delhi NCR.
The companies plan to expand the offering to other Indian cities. The partnership combines GSM VinFast’s EV ecosystem with ARC Electric’s corporate mobility expertise to provide businesses with premium and sustainable transportation options. Services will cover daily employee commutes, airport transfers, on-demand travel and other corporate requirements. The initiative forms part of GSM VinFast’s broader 2,000-cab collaboration and aims to help organisations integrate EVs into regular transportation while advancing sustainability and carbon-reduction goals.
WACKER sets up Global Capability Center in Pune with HCLTech
Wacker Chemie AG has established a Global Capability Center in Pune in collaboration with HCLTech. The centre will support WACKER’s engineering, IT and digital transformation initiatives while providing a flexible and future-ready delivery foundation. Fabian Seibold, Director, WACKER Excellence Hub Pune, said the centre would strengthen the company’s global delivery and digital execution capabilities, while HCLTech’s experience in building and scaling such centres would support agility, governance and long-term growth.
Dr Frank Fehler, Executive Vice President and Country Head-Germany at HCLTech, said the expanded engagement marks an important milestone in WACKER’s digital transformation. The new centre builds on the strategic partnership between the two companies and is intended to support WACKER’s long-term engineering and digital transformation journey.
Wipro expands Google Cloud partnership on Gemini Enterprise
Wipro has expanded its partnership with Google Cloud to accelerate enterprise-wide adoption of Gemini Enterprise and agentic AI. As part of the initiative, Wipro is scaling its internal deployment of Gemini Enterprise and plans to empower more than 10,000 AI-certified specialists, including 1,500 Forward Deployed Engineers, with advanced AI capabilities.
The company has also launched the LIFT (Launch-Ignite-Flywheel-Transform) framework to help enterprises accelerate AI transformation and operationalise agentic AI at scale. Powered by Wipro Intelligence, LIFT integrates Gemini Enterprise with Wipro’s AI-powered delivery platforms, WINGS and WEGA. The combined ecosystem is designed to help businesses move beyond basic task automation towards secure, autonomous AI agents embedded in multi-step workflows. Wipro is building a dedicated team of more than 1,500 certified FDEs to scale AI adoption.
Three medtech startups selected for Ginserv accelerator
Three Indian medtech startups have emerged as winners of HealthSprint 2026, a joint initiative of the Consulate General of Israel in Bengaluru and Bengaluru-based Techstartup Accelerator GINSERV, aimed at helping Indian healthcare innovators strengthen their businesses, investability and expand into global markets.
The three winners are: BioCipher Labs, Bengaluru, an AI-powered molecular diagnostics startup, Prodancy, Bengaluru, a medtech company that has developed an indigenous surgical helmet for joint replacement procedures, aimed at replacing imported consumables and Mykare.ai, Kochi, an AI-native patient management platform designed for clinics and smaller hospitals. The winners will receive a fully funded, one-week immersive programme in Israel, giving them an opportunity to engage with the country’s healthcare and innovation ecosystem and explore pathways to validate, scale and expand their businesses into global markets.
Kore.ai named Leader by three analyst firms
Enterprise AI platform company Kore.ai has been named a Leader by Gartner, Forrester and Everest Group in their latest evaluations of the enterprise AI market. The recognitions span five categories: agentic AI products, conversational AI platforms, customer service, employee services and enterprise search. Kore.ai said the recognition across three independent analyst firms carries significance because each evaluates the market using different criteria, perspectives and assessment cycles.
The company’s technology portfolio includes conversational AI, generative AI and agentic AI capabilities. Kore.ai also highlighted its patent portfolio covering areas such as agent definition language, constraint enforcement, multi-agent coordination, agent evaluation and governance.
Netscout enhances Arbor Edge Defense against DDoS attacks
Netscout has announced enhancements to its Arbor Edge Defense solution, aimed at helping enterprises protect mission-critical and revenue-generating applications from sophisticated distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks. The enhanced solution is designed to identify malicious sources concealed behind shared content delivery network infrastructure and apply service-specific countermeasures.
This allows organisations to block attacks while continuing to provide access to legitimate customers using the same CDN. The updated AED capabilities include revealing attack sources hidden by CDN proxies, stopping application-layer attacks and protecting applications through service-specific policies. Netscout said the solution can also preserve legitimate customer access, defend both direct and CDN-mediated traffic paths, and extend existing CDN investments.

articles.title: Les données de 13 millions de clients Carhartt exposées par le groupe ShinyHunters
articles.text:
Carhartt rejoint la longue liste des victimes de ShinyHunters.
Le géant américain du vêtement de travail, devenu une marque de mode grand public, a vu les données de près de 13 millions de comptes clients diffusées sur le dark web par le groupe de cybercriminels.
Selon les informations relayées par le service de notification Have I Been Pwned le 25 août 2026, le 13 août 2026, le groupe cybercriminel ShinyHunters a revendiqué le vol de plus de 50 Go de documents auprès de l’entreprise. L’exfiltration elle-même semble toutefois remonter au début du mois d’août.
Un chantage resté sans réponse
Les hackers assurent avoir mis la main sur des données clients, employés et internes à la société, ainsi que sur des informations liées à un programme de fidélité.
Selon le média américain Bleeping Computer, la divulgation de ces données serait l’aboutissement d’un chantage mené depuis plusieurs jours. Face au refus de Carhartt de payer la rançon réclamée, 3,3 millions de dollars, les pirates ont donc publié l’archive complète sur leur site de fuites.
Un négociateur de l’entreprise leur aurait signifié, selon les propos rapportés par ShinyHunters lui-même, la fin des discussions après un examen interne du dossier.
Carhartt n’a pour l’instant ni confirmé ni commenté publiquement l’incident.
Un bilan deux fois moins lourd qu’annoncé
C’est en épluchant l’archive divulguée que Troy Hunt, le fondateur de Have I Been Pwned, a pu établir l’origine de la fuite. Dans un article de blog publié le 26 août 2026, il explique avoir identifié une compromission de la plateforme d’analyse de données Databricks utilisée par Carhartt pour centraliser son reporting et son stockage de données dans le cloud.
Son analyse révèle toutefois un écart notable avec les annonces initiales de ShinyHunters : sur les près de 25 millions d’adresses e-mail extraites de l’archive, une bonne moitié s’est révélée être des enregistrements « synthétiques », des données de test générées automatiquement, mélangées aux vraies données clients sur la même plateforme Databricks.
Une fois ce bruit écarté, Hunt établit donc le chiffre réel à 12,9 millions de comptes concernés, avec adresses e-mail, noms, numéros de téléphone et adresses postales exposés. Plus de 15 000 adresses e-mail internes en @carhartt.com figurent également dans le lot, signe que les données des salariés ont aussi été touchées.
À noter que ce vecteur d’attaque est habituel pour ShinyHunters, dont la méthode privilégiée consiste à cibler des plateformes de données tierces plutôt que les systèmes internes des entreprises elles-mêmes, à l’image de ses campagnes contre des clients de Salesforce.

articles.title: How Nigeria’s TechAble is bridging the digital inclusion gap for young people with disabilities - Disrupt Africa
articles.text:
Nigeria’s TechAble is a an inclusive digital skills and youth empowerment initiative focused on expanding access to technology, STEM education, and future-ready skills for young people in Africa, particularly those with disabilities and from underserved communities.
Formed in 2024 as an initiative of Deafzion Foundation, a Nigeria-based social impact organisation focused on disability rights, inclusive education, and youth empowerment, TechAble came about in response to growing digital exclusion among young people with disabilities.
Through bootcamps, workshops, and community-based programmes, TechAble equips learners with digital literacy, data and AI fundamentals, problem-solving, leadership, and employability skills, while also advocating for inclusive technology ecosystems in Africa.
We identified a major gap in disability-inclusive tech education. While many digital skills programmes exist, very few are intentionally designed to accommodate learners with disabilities or operate within inclusive learning environments,” Emmanuel Izuchukwu Osita, executive director of the Deafzion Foundation and TechAble lead, told Disrupt Africa.
“TechAble differentiates itself by embedding accessibility, inclusive pedagogy, assistive technologies, and psychosocial support into digital skills training.”
Currently funded through grants, partnerships, donations, and in-kind support, the initiative has already trained over 40 youths with disabilities across Nigeria in digital and AI skills, and secured partnerships with organisations such as LEAP Africa, Dow, Windows on America, and state disability agencies.
“Uptake has been strong and organic. We have recorded high interest from students, parents, schools, and partner organisations. Participation rates are high, with strong retention and engagement, particularly among girls with disabilities,” said Osita.
TechAble currently operates in Nasarawa State, Abuja, and Plateau State.
“We plan to expand across other Nigerian states and into selected African countries through partnerships with schools, NGOs, and development agencies,” Osita said.
“Key challenges include limited funding, accessibility costs, infrastructure constraints in underserved areas, and low awareness around disability-inclusive tech education. However, strong community support, partnerships, and demand have enabled us to overcome early-stage challenges and continue scaling.”

articles.title: Cloudflare Wallets Arrives Late to x402, and the Spending Controls Stop at the Payment
articles.text:
Cloudflare announced Cloudflare Wallets during its Agents Week, giving AI agents a stablecoin balance and a cloudflare.pay handle to present when paying for APIs, data, and content. Only claiming a handle works today. Funding and payment are described as arriving in the coming months.
The one shipped feature is already drawing complaints. On Hacker News, commenter merek found his company name and several variants taken:
Without domain validation, what is this user's intention other than fraud/impersonation?
He added that he already has an impersonator running a website under his brand and confusing customers. Commenter nikolay contrasted the rollout with how Meta handled reserved usernames, giving advance notice and an equal start, and drew a conclusion about the product:
What Cloudflare did is basically push me not to use their offering, because I couldn't get my username.
Payments run on x402, which repurposes the HTTP 402 Payment Required status code for machine-native micropayments. Coinbase originated it, and the Linux Foundation now hosts it with around 40 members including Cloudflare, Stripe, Visa, Mastercard, Google, and Amazon Web Services. MCP followed the same path from a single vendor to the Agentic AI Foundation, and for the same reason. A protocol every competitor must implement is worth more to its originator inside a foundation than under its own control.
Foundation hosting settles who owns the specification without settling who competes on it, and Cloudflare arrives late to a field that already includes rails from AWS, Google Cloud, Circle, and the card networks. Its case rests on distribution. Wallets is the buy-side complement to the Monetization Gateway it launched on July 1, which lets sites and APIs charge agents per request over the same rails. Holding both sides means merchants who can charge agents and agents that can pay them, across a network Cloudflare says spans 337 cities and touches roughly one in five websites.
Several commenters read the announcement as being about something other than payments. Commenter eddythompson80 argued that agent identity has so far been trapped inside individual systems, since an identity AWS IAM assigns will not work on an unrelated website, and that OIDC federation is too complex for ordinary sites to adopt. The obstacle was never the mechanism but agreement on a provider:
Agreeing on the single IdP was the problem, there are like 40.
His conclusion was that Cloudflare has spotted the opening:
There is a legitimate need for that, and it looks like cloudflare figured if they are that "internet agent identity provider", then there is a lot of power and control over the internet and AI use in general.
Commenter wxw made the platform version of the same point, noting that Durable Objects and Workers are good agent primitives, so a team already using them may as well take the wallet, sandbox, and AI gateway too. Others were less comfortable. Commenter Ycros wrote that Cloudflare keeps inserting itself between everything, drawing a reply from nater5000 that a company building products in its own market with clear demand needs no further explanation.
The part worth reading closely is the control model. Each account holder gets an Account Wallet and can create separate Virtual Wallets per agent, funded from the main account and bounded by three controls the owner sets: an allowance, an allow-list of approved merchants, and a maximum transaction size. The stated intent is that an agent can test and buy services without a human approving each payment, with a hard ceiling on the damage.
Account Wallets and per-agent Virtual Wallets in the Cloudflare dashboard (Source: Cloudflare blog)
Those primitives describe a budget rather than a policy. An allowance is a running total. An allow-list is a set membership test. A maximum transaction size is a per-request bound. Each evaluates the current payment against a fixed limit, and none expresses a relationship between payments.
Rules that platform teams tend to want do express relationships. An agent may only pay a vendor it has already checked against an approved catalog. It may not pay two vendors for the same thing within an hour. It must obtain approval before a first purchase from a new merchant. Each requires reasoning about the sequence rather than the current request.
Concurrency raises a related question. Agents issue actions in parallel, so several payments can be checked against an allowance that none of them has yet reduced, and each passes a ceiling their sum exceeds. Cloudflare has not published how its allowance behaves under concurrent spending, and that is worth establishing before letting an agent transact without per-payment approval.
The pattern is not particular to Cloudflare. Providers in this space ship limits rather than policy languages, and each leaves the composition of those limits to the application above.
For teams evaluating agent payments, the questions are narrow. Where does the spending policy live, at the wallet or in the application? What happens when several agent actions run in parallel against one budget? And whether a provider ships limits or a language, because that determines how much has to be built in-house.
x402 is a working rail, and the question of who governs it is settled. What an agent can spend across a sequence of payments is not.

articles.title: Roomba Max 775 Combo, análisis: este robot aspirador es tan infalible con el pelo que estoy pensando tener otro perro en casa
articles.text:
Esta iRobot ya no es la que era en términos empresariales, pero hay algo que no cambia: sigue haciendo muy buenos robots aspiradores. Es cierto que en cuestiones de innovación ya no va tanto por libre y ha abrazado algunas tecnologías populares en el segmento, como por ejemplo el fregado mediante rodillo y que esta pueda deslizarse a los lados para llegar a las esquinas, pero por qué no decirlo: he probado un montón de robots aspiradores y tengo que decir que es lo que mejor friega en la actualidad. La ficha técnica de este Roomba Max 775 Combo promete, así que lo hemos probado a fondo para comprobar si rinde a la altura.
✅ Cómpralo si...
- Tienes una casa grande.
- En tu hogar hay mascotas.
- Quieres un robot aspirador completo pero fácil de usar.
❌ No lo compres si...
- Quieres que tu aspirador sea compatible con Matter.
- Tu presupuesto es ajustado.
- Vives en un piso pequeño.
Lo esencial en 30 segundos
El Roomba Max 775 Combo con base AutoWash es el robot aspirador que recomendaría a quien tiene un hogar con mascotas y grande. Es cierto que aspira y friega bien en general, pero su combo de potencia de succión y cepillos de goma resulta de lo más efectivo para esos pelitos que se depositan el suelo y, por qué no decirlo, también con las bolas que se acumulan. Como además tiene una navegación solvente y pila para rato, da para recorrer muchos metros cuadrados.
Me ha sorprendido por el poco mantenimiento que requiere y, algo que no es una sorpresa pero que sigo agradeciendo enormemente: lo bien que está hecha su app. Hoy en día es habitual encontrar aplicaciones abarrotadas de funciones (es el caso), pero iRobot es de las pocas que las integra en una interfaz ágil e intuitiva.
En pocas palabras, esta característica viene de lujo para esas personas que quieren un robot aspirador ambicioso pero no son gente tech, por lo que controlar dispositivos desde el móvil se les hace bola. Por ejemplo, mi madre se apaña con Whatsapp y poco más y también se maneja con esta app.
iRobot Roomba Max 775 Combo Base AutoWash multifunción y Agua Caliente, 30.000 Pascales, Rodillo PowerSpin Extensible, Cubierta Protectora, 2 cepillos, Fregado/Secado con Calor, LiDAR 3D con IA, Negro
Nuestra experiencia con el Roomba Max 775 Combo
Sobresaliente en diseño. Aparte de que tiene una estética que entra por los ojos, el Roomba Max 775 Combo está diseñado con mucha cabeza: su base no se siente especialmente grande, pero está optimizada para que el mantenimiento sea mínimo. En cuanto al cuerpo, es algo más grande de lo normal, pero le sienta de lujo para cubrir más espacio en menos pasadas o sortear obstáculos y como no tiene txapela, cabe bien por debajo de las puertas de armarios. Pero lo mejor está en los bajos: doble cepillo lateral para cubrir bien los lados y doble rodillo de goma central magnífico para atrapar pelo y evitar enredos. Donde se han esmerado especialmente es en el rodillo para fregar: es grande, tiene tapa (por si pasa por alfombras) y sale a los lados.
Imperdible. Para moverse por casa tiene una cámara con reconocimiento con IA y un visor láser integrado en el cuerpo y la verdad, es de los robots aspiradores que más rápido ha recorrido mi casa y que mejor lo ha hecho sin necesidad de quitar nada. Es más, no molesta ni a las perras. Eso sí: obviamente si tienes la casa llena de trastos y los esquiva, por ahí debajo no limpia y como los cepillos laterales no son extraíbles, no apura tan bien las esquinas como otros. En mis semanas de prueba nunca se ha perdido ni se ha tragado nada y ha calculado bien donde cabe para no escatimar en esfuerzos. Va muy fino en navegación.
Mano de santo con el pelo. Dejando al margen las limitaciones propias de diseño, por capacidad de succión y configuración de cepillos este es uno de los mejores robots aspiradores que he probado con el pelo, algo que he comprobado tanto en el baño con los cabellos que se nos caen como andando en calcetines por casa después de limpiar: normalmente, siempre queda algún pelo que se incrusta en el textil, pero con este robot se ha reducido a casi cero y sin necesidad de ponerlo a máxima potencia. El fregado también me ha dejado con un gran sabor de boca: "ve" las manchas y el agua caliente con jabón y la rotación da buenos resultados en general (aunque alguna mancha se resiste). Como se va lavando sola, no va arrastrando la suciedad de un lado a otro.
Le sobra batería para pisos grandes. iRobot no ha proporcionado datos sobre la batería ni su duración, así que hemos usado nuestro sistema homogeinizador: ponerlo solo a aspirar a máxima potencia y ver cuánto gasta. En 40 minutos limpió un apartamento de 55 metros cuadrados consumiendo un 33%, lo que permitiría al menos más de dos limpiezas completas. No obstante, no será lo habitual ponerlo a tope ni solo a aspirar, por lo que va sobrado para pisos de 100 metros cuadrados. Además, si se queda seco, vuelve a la base a cargarse lo suficiente para completar la misión de limpieza.
Hace brujería con el agua. Como cualquier otro aspirador de gama alta, tiene una bolsa para guardar la suciedad que aspira, un depósito de agua limpia para fregar y limpiarse y otro de agua sucia para acumularla. Esta combinación permite un mantenimiento mínimo y exposición mínima a alérgenos como el polvo, pero algo que me ha llamado la atención es la poca agua que consume: es normal que tenga que llenar el bidón al menos una vez a la semana, pero con este casi dura el doble. Por otro lado y pese a estar en una casa difícil, el aspirador no ha acumulado bolas de pelo en los cepillos en estas semanas de prueba. En el debe, los recambios de estas nuevas bolsas mejoradas para las alergias son aún más caros y la muestra de limpiador se me acabó pronto y al recurrir a la tienda me llevé la misma sorpresa.

|---|---|

| Fregado | Sistema de fregado con agua caliente a 75 °C y 200 rpm. rodillo PerfectEdge extensible | 
| Base | Capacidad depósito sólidos: bolsa AllergenLock con control de olores hasta 90 días Limpieza mopa con agua caliente a 75 °C y secado con aire caliente a 50 °C | 
| conectividad | Compatible con Alexa, Siri y Google Home. | 
| Autonomía | n.d. | 
| Qué hay en la caja | Base, robot aspirador, cable, manuales, bolsa de polvo extra, dos cepillos laterales de recambio, frasco de muestra de limpiador | 
| Precio | 899 euros | 
Roomba Max 775 Combo, la opinión de Xataka
Acercaros, que os voy a contar una intimidad: cuando conocí a mi pareja, que tuviera dos perras enormes era algo que daba un poco de vértigo y una de las razones es la suciedad: los pelos que se caen, las babas, la vuelta de pasear por el campo... este Roomba Max 775 Combo se ha convertido en mi mejor aliado por lo bien que atrapa el pelo y también porque limpia todo lo que saliva esa perra glotona mientras nos ve preparar comida desde el umbral de la puerta de la cocina.
Con este robot aspirador, iRobot ha mantenido bazas como su magnífica navegación o su diseño premium y de calidad tanto del dispositivo (y su elemento estrella, los cepillos) como de la app y ha subido el nivel en limpieza. Este modelo concreto sigue la estela de su antecesor y es el mejor aspirando en hogares con mascotas ya que ha subido la capacidad de succión, pero es que además hay pocos rivales en el mercado capaz de toserle en fregado. El único "pero" que le pondría es que ya que se extrae el rodillo de fregar, que también lo hagan los cepillos laterales.
¿Lo recomiendo?
Rotundamente, sí. Salvo la particularidad de Matter o que tengas un estudio de reducidas dimensiones y no puedas despilfarrarlo con una señora base, este Roomba Max 775 Combo me parece una compra maestra en líneas generales. Y además, para lo completo que es y su calidad, tiene un precio de lo más atractivo dentro de la gama alta.

articles.title: Australia Arrests 2 Alleged TeamPCP Hackers
articles.text:
Two men suspected of being members of the notorious cybercrime group TeamPCP have been arrested and charged by Australian authorities.
The suspects, Ruben Ian Thomson, 21, and Louis Michael Gaebler, 23, have been arrested in Perth. They face several charges related to their alleged role in a cybercrime syndicate that is believed to have caused financial losses totaling hundreds of millions of dollars.
Thomson has been charged with five types of offenses related to computer hacking and money laundering. He faces between 3 and 20 years in prison for each charge. Gaebler has been charged with computer hacking, and the most serious counts carry a maximum prison sentence of 5 years.
TeamPCP compromised major software supply chains and developer security tools, including Aqua Security’s Trivy, Checkmarx’s KICS, and PyPI’s LiteLLM, to siphon over 500,000 corporate credentials from compromised CI/CD pipelines.
By hijacking automated build workflows and popular package registries, the group systematically transformed corporate software pipelines into data-harvesting networks, funneling stolen cloud access keys and infrastructure secrets to extortion and ransomware groups.
TeamPCP deployed the Mini Shai-Hulud worm (and likely the original Shai-Hulud) to automate credential theft and self-propagation across package registries at scale.
According to Australian police, the hacker group exfiltrated at least 300 GB of data from more than 1,000 organizations worldwide.
Police have seized devices belonging to Thomson and Gaebler and are working to determine how much money they have earned from their illegal activities.
“A large volume of data seized is being forensically examined and the investigation remains ongoing. Further arrests and charges have not been ruled out,” the Australian Federal Police announced on Thursday.

articles.title: Google lanza Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, una nueva IA para generar vídeos profesionales que es una bestia
articles.text:
Google acaba de lanzar Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, su nueva IA para generar vídeos de calidad profesional. La nueva versión construye sobre lo que ya vimos a mediados de año con Gemini Omni y lo lleva a un nivel más alto gracias a la implementación de varias características que destacan tanto por su utilidad como por su potencia.
Los de Mountain View destacan que la función más importante del nuevo Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash es la extensión de escenas. La inteligencia artificial puede tomar un vídeo ya existente y expandirlo hasta 40 segundos de forma cohesiva, sin poner en riesgo la narración o la consistencia del material.
Un elemento crucial aquí es que, a diferencia de lo que sucedía con la primera versión de Omni, la tecnología puede sacar provecho de un contexto más amplio. Esto se debe a que Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash puede analizar los últimos 10 segundos del vídeo que se pretende extender, y no el segundo final. Así, se logran resultados más fieles al material original con el que se está trabajando.
Vale aclarar que, si bien la extensión de escenas con Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash soporta hasta 40 segundos de agregado, no los crea de una sola vez. El modelo que impulsa la herramienta admite incrementos de hasta 10 segundos, indican desde la firma californiana.
Otra característica interesante de Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash es que puede generar vídeos utilizando como base el primer y el último fotograma que le provee el usuario. Esto significa que puedes darle dos imágenes de referencia sobre cómo debe empezar y cómo terminar el clip, y la IA se encarga de crear el resto.
Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash llega promete vídeos de calidad profesional
Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash también introduce una opción para desarrollar ideas para un vídeo, evolucionarlas y aplicar cambios de un modo más veloz y menos costoso. Si quieres usar la IA para armar una suerte de borrador del proyecto, antes de avanzar con la generación de una versión final.
La clave aquí es que se puede trabajar sobre un "prototipo" en calidad 360p, de modo que funciona más rápido y es más barato. Así, si hay algo que no te convence del resultado que obtienes, puedes cambiarlo sin estar restringido por los costes o posibles demoras.
Como no podía ser de otra manera, Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash también sirve para escalar vídeos a resoluciones más altas que la del material original. Así que se puede aprovechar para transformar clips con calidades menores a 1080p o 4K. Por supuesto que el coste depende no solo de la calidad, sino también de la extensión del vídeo.
Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash ya se encuentra disponible para todos los suscriptores de Google AI Plus, Pro y Ultra a través de Google Flow. Por su parte, la función de expandir una escena también llega a la app de Gemini para quienes cuenten con alguno de los citados planes de pago. Y la IA también está disponible en la API y a través de Google AI Studio.
Respecto de sus precios, cuesta 3 centavos de dólar por segundo creado en 360p, 10 centavos de dólar por segundo en 720p, 15 centavos de dólar por segundo en 1080p y 30 centavos de dólar por segundo en 4K.

articles.title: Ubisoft releases Heroes of Might and Magic III on Steam, forgets to include the actual game files
articles.text:
Facepalm: Soon after announcing an upcoming remake of its celebrated turn-based strategy game, Ubisoft finally brought the original version of Heroes of Might and Magic III to Steam. However, the first customers to purchase the classic title couldn't launch it for what is likely one of the most embarrassing reasons ever for a Steam release.
The original 1999 version of Heroes of Might and Magic III appeared on Steam for the first time on Tuesday. However, users had to wait an extra day to play the game because Ubisoft accidentally made it available on the storefront without uploading the necessary files.
Customers who installed the turn-based strategy game on day one received only about 23KB of files, including a dummy executable, even though the system requirements claim it needs 1GB of storage space. Warnings quickly spread on the Steam forums and in the game's negative reviews. One review called it 23.49KB of pure nostalgia and the best CMD prompt simulator of 2026. Ubisoft resolved the issue early the following day, responding to one review that simply contained the increasingly relevant quote, "You will own nothing and be happy."
Heroes of Might and Magic III became one of the most well-regarded turn-based tactical RPGs following its 1999 release. However, for years, the only version available on Steam was a 2015 remaster with a mixed reputation. Although its high-resolution graphics make the game more accessible on modern displays, it lacks the original game's two expansions, and some critics argued that free HD mods of the original were already sufficient. The new release, which includes the expansions, brings Steam's offering in line with what has long been available on GOG and other storefronts.
Ubisoft re-released Heroes of Might and Magic III soon after announcing a remake, set for launch sometime next year. While the HD mods and the 2015 version simply render the original 2D graphics at a higher resolution, the remake promises to rebuild everything in the Snowdrop engine that powers Ubisoft's modern games.
Gameplay-related enhancements include a new overhead view that zooms out to display more of the game's maps while simplifying player icons. Battles can also now be viewed from multiple angles while players read newly available tooltips.
Furthermore, players can now assign roles to heroes on the main map, allowing them to automatically perform tasks like collecting resources and transporting troops. Combat can also be automated, and a new wish list screen provides a long-term view of construction projects, while the inventory screen has been overhauled.
For new players, the remake also includes a prologue campaign, which acts as a tutorial. After finishing the campaign, users can generate new maps randomly or download community maps, including maps designed for the original version.
The Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake will be available next year on Steam, the Ubisoft Store, and the Epic Games Store.

articles.title: Propinas para robots: la polémica detrás de la automatización en bares y cafeterías
articles.text:
La llegada de robots a bares y cafeterías está transformando la experiencia de pedir una bebida, pero también ha encendido un debate global: ¿tiene sentido dejar propina a una máquina?
Lo que parecía una rareza tecnológica en lugares como Las Vegas y Nueva York se está expandiendo hacia otras ciudades y países, impulsando preguntas sobre el futuro laboral, la justicia salarial y la ética de la automatización en el sector servicios.
PUBLICIDAD
El fenómeno de las propinas para robots desafía las reglas tradicionales de la industria y refleja las tensiones entre innovación, reconocimiento y transparencia. Hoy, la decisión de dejar o no una propina a un robot comienza a definir nuevas normas en un sector marcado por la búsqueda de eficiencia y la digitalización acelerada.
Robótica y propinas: una zona gris en la economía digital
Cómo fue registrado en un artículo de la BBC, en bares como The Tipsy Robot en Las Vegas, los brazos robóticos que preparan cócteles son parte del atractivo. Sin embargo, tras finalizar el pedido, las pantallas digitales suelen pedir una propina, incluso cuando no interviene personal humano en la entrega.
PUBLICIDAD
Según representantes de estos locales, el dinero recaudado se reparte entre los trabajadores, pero no existe una normativa clara que lo garantice.
La profesora asociada Holona Ochs, de la Universidad de Lehigh y coautora del libro “Gratuity”, advierte que la falta de una regulación específica sobre las propinas en sistemas automatizados genera incertidumbre, ya que no siempre queda claro si el dinero recaudado beneficia realmente a los empleados o es retenido por las empresas.
PUBLICIDAD
Esta falta de transparencia plantea dudas sobre quién se ve favorecido y quién asume el costo en el nuevo escenario de la automatización en el sector servicios.
Cultura de la propina, automatización y el dilema del cliente
El debate es especialmente intenso en Estados Unidos, donde la propina es una parte esencial del ingreso de los empleados y permite a las empresas mantener salarios base bajos. En este contexto, la proliferación de terminales digitales y la normalización de la solicitud de propinas han dado origen a lo que muchos consumidores describen como “chantaje emocional”, con porcentajes sugeridos cada vez más altos y en servicios automatizados.
PUBLICIDAD
El vacío legal sobre quién recibe realmente el dinero se agrava cuando la máquina es la que solicita la propina. La administración Trump, según señala Ochs, dificultó que los empleados presenten reclamaciones sobre problemas con las propinas, y si los empleadores se quedan con el dinero dado a los robots, es difícil de rastrear o denunciar.
¿Propinas a robots o a personas? El dilema ético y psicológico
La profesora Katerina Berezina, de la Universidad de Misisipi, estudia la tecnología en el sector hotelero y matiza que la automatización no es necesariamente negativa para los trabajadores. Según Berezina, el atractivo de los robots puede crear nuevos empleos y oportunidades, aunque advierte que la clave está en la intención y la ejecución: “La moralidad depende de cómo se implemente la tecnología y de quién se beneficie realmente”.
PUBLICIDAD
El fenómeno de las propinas para robots refleja una crisis más profunda: la escasez de mano de obra, la presión por reducir costos y la búsqueda de eficiencia con inteligencia artificial. Algunos grupos, como One Fair Wage, denuncian que la automatización es una excusa para mantener salarios bajos y perpetuar la precarización laboral en la industria.
Para otros expertos los robots pueden complementar el trabajo humano y mejorar la experiencia del cliente sin desplazar a los empleados, siempre que las empresas actúen con integridad. El futuro dependerá de la respuesta de los consumidores: si la práctica se percibe como injusta, es probable que las empresas ajusten sus políticas o abandonen la idea.
PUBLICIDAD
La expansión de las propinas para robots es un síntoma de la transformación de la economía digital y la tensión entre innovación y equidad. Mientras la tecnología redefine el trabajo y la interacción social, la decisión de dejar una propina, o no, se convierte en una declaración sobre el valor del servicio y la justicia en la era de la automatización.
PUBLICIDAD
