articles.title: The Best Windows Uninstaller Tools for Wiping Out Stubborn Software
articles.text:
Windows can remove most desktop software and Microsoft Store apps on its own, and for routine uninstalls, the built-in tools are usually enough. A third-party uninstaller becomes useful when a program's removal process is broken, you need to remove many apps at once, or you want to scrub residual files and registry keys that are often left behind.
Most of these utilities first run the program's own uninstaller, then scan for residual folders, files, services, scheduled tasks, and registry entries. Some can also monitor an installation from the beginning, which gives them a much more accurate record of what should be removed later.
No leftover scanner is infallible though. Shared files and registry entries can produce false positives, so review aggressive cleanup results and create a restore point or backup before removing anything important. Leftover registry entries also do not normally slow down modern versions of Windows, and registry cleaners should be reserved for troubleshooting specific problems rather than routine maintenance.
Here are the Windows uninstallers worthy of your consideration, that go from simple portable tools to power user suites built for batch removal and closely monitored installations.
For Fast and Friendly Use
These Windows uninstallers are noteworthy for their polished interfaces and ease of use.
IObit Uninstaller
IObit Uninstaller is one of the most polished and widely used freemium choices. Its modern interface displays app icons, installation details, and disk usage, while clear categories make it easy to find large, infrequently used, recently installed, or bundled programs. Icons and disk usage stats help you manage your installed software.
It supports batch removal, forced uninstall, residual-file scans, Microsoft Store apps, browser extensions, and detection of bundleware or potentially unwanted programs. Its Install Monitor can record changes made during a new setup, giving IObit a better map of what to reverse if that software is removed later.
The Software Health section also collects update checks, permission controls, notification management, and cleanup suggestions in one place.
IObit Uninstaller is also specifically designed to detect hidden bundleware (adware or potentially unwanted programs) and force-removing other stubborn, difficult-to-remove applications. Additionally, it provides dedicated management for allowing you to remove pre-installed Microsoft Store apps and browser plugins across Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Opera.
For proactive maintenance, a real-time installation monitor tracks system modifications during new installations so that they can be completely reverted later, restoring your Windows system to its prior state.
Geek Uninstaller
Geek Uninstaller features a clean and minimalist UI. The free edition arrives as a small portable executable, opens almost instantly, and presents installed desktop programs and Microsoft Store apps in a simple searchable list. It runs each program's own uninstaller, then offers to remove detected remnants.
The free build is limited to personal use and removes programs individually, but that is enough for most troubleshooting jobs. Because it requires no installation, it is also a handy addition to a repair USB drive or a system on which you do not want to add another permanent utility.
The paid Geek Uninstaller Pro link leads to Uninstall Tool, a separately branded commercial edition from the same developer. It adds batch removal, real-time installation monitoring, startup management, technical support, and a more modern multi-panel interface.
HiBit Uninstaller
HiBit Uninstaller is possibly the most feature-packed free option in this group. Available in installable and portable versions, it supports batch removal, a "force uninstall" mode for corrupted software, installation monitoring, and leftover scans. Additionally, it can specifically remove Windows Store apps and browser extensions.
It also bundles tools for managing startup entries, services, scheduled tasks, context-menu items, restore points, junk files, and sensitive-file deletion. That breadth makes HiBit a good choice if you want to replace several small Windows utilities with one suite, although its interface is a tad busy and many people will not need every module.
Beyond uninstallation, HiBit offers real-time monitoring, junk file cleaning, and file tools like a shredder. Its registry tools are best left alone unless you are diagnosing a specific problem. The core uninstaller, force-removal, and startup-management features are the real reasons to use HiBit.
IObit Uninstaller: A faster, cleaner way to remove software from your PC
The built-in Windows uninstaller can leave files, folders, and registry entries behind – IObit Uninstaller is built to catch what gets missed.
The free version handles standard and batch removal, while Pro takes it further: automated cleanup, a database covering 4,000+ notoriously stubborn programs, auto-updates for your third-party software, and a real-time install monitor that can roll back changes if a new program misbehaves.
sponsored message
Revo Uninstaller
Revo Uninstaller has a long-standing reputation, an approachable interface. Revo is a go-to for advanced users thanks to its multi-stage cleanup. It creates a restore point and registry backup before running the uninstaller, then performs a deep scan for any leftover data using Safe, Moderate, or Advanced settings.
It uses a sensible workflow: run the application's built-in uninstaller first, then scan for related files, folders, and registry entries that remain. The free version is sufficient for occasional use, while Pro makes more sense for people who frequently test or replace software.
Its unique "Hunter Mode" provides an interactive way to target apps. A small crosshair floats on your desktop; dragging it onto any window or icon gives you instant options to uninstall, kill the process, or open its folder. It makes managing software feel more intuitive.
Revo also includes dedicated tools to remove pre-installed Windows 10/11 bloatware and browser plugins. But the free version lacks batch uninstallation and real-time monitoring.
For Power Users
These uninstallers expose more of the detection and automation process. They are better suited to clearing a heavily loaded PC, testing software, or inspecting exactly what an application changed.
Bulk Crap Uninstaller
Bulk Crap Uninstaller, also known as BCUninstaller or BCU, is the standout open-source option for removing large numbers of programs. BCU lacks UI polish, but this free tool is the go-to for system administrators. It was designed with IT professionals in mind, but its guided workflow is accessible to anyone willing to spend a few minutes learning the interface.
BCU detects far more than conventional desktop software, including orphaned entries, portable apps, Microsoft Store apps, Windows features, Steam games, and programs registered through numerous installer systems. It can queue many uninstallers, attempt their quiet commands, and run them in a controlled order to reduce conflicts and repetitive prompts.
The interface is dense, but the detail is useful. Color coding and filters help distinguish app types, while the leftover scanner assigns confidence ratings so you can separate likely remnants from uncertain matches. It is the best fit for cleaning up an OEM PC, a test system, or a large software library, although simpler tools can be quicker for removing a single everyday app.
Uninstalr
Uninstalr is a newer, actively developed utility built around thorough detection and highly automated batch removal. It is free, lightweight, and available as both an installed application and a portable executable. Before removing anything, it can show the files, folders, registry entries, services, and other items it associates with the selected software.
Its custom engine recognizes conventional Windows programs, MS Store apps, portable software, and games installed through Steam, EA, Epic, Riot, and GOG. It also supports software managed through tools such as Chocolatey, NuGet, and Ninite. Unattended batch mode is the main attraction, allowing many programs to be queued with substantially less manual interaction than most rivals require.
Uninstalr's aggressive leftover detection is both its strength and its risk. Recent releases have improved accuracy and added more confirmation safeguards, but power users should still inspect the removal plan and use its System Restore option before a large automated cleanup. It is a strong choice when maximum automation matters more than conservative behavior of other tools.
Outdated drivers are quietly slowing down your PC
Outdated drivers are a quiet cause of slow performance, display glitches, and dropped connections.
Driver Booster scans your system, checks each driver against a database of millions of the latest versions, and updates what's outdated in a couple of clicks. It's especially handy after a fresh Windows install or a new GPU, when several drivers need updating at once. Backup and restore is built in, so you can roll back any driver that causes trouble.
sponsored message
Total Uninstall
Total Uninstall is a commercial Windows classic aimed at users who want a detailed record of every change. For existing software, it analyzes the installation, builds a tree of associated files and registry entries, runs the supplied uninstaller, and then lets you review what remains. While its data-heavy UI is designed for experts, it remains a reliable go-to for those who need to inspect every digital footprint an app leaves behind.
Its stronger Monitored Programs mode takes snapshots before and after a new installation. The resulting log can later be used to reverse the recorded file-system and registry changes without relying entirely on the application's own removal routine. This approach is especially useful on test machines where software is installed and removed frequently. The paid Professional edition can also back up applications and transfer supported programs to another PC.
Other Popular Uninstaller Tools
These established utilities can still be useful, but each comes with a reason it falls short of the recommendations above.
Wise Program Uninstaller
Wise Program Uninstaller is a lightweight and approachable replacement for Windows' Installed Apps panel. In addition to normal removal and residual scanning, it offers forced and custom uninstall modes for programs with broken entries or missing uninstallers. It is a solid choice if you want something more capable than Windows without the complexity of a full power-user suite. It can also remove browser extensions and add an uninstall command to the Windows context menu.
CCleaner
CCleaner is one of the best-known Windows cleanup utilities, but its uninstaller is not equivalent to the dedicated tools above. It provides a convenient list of installed programs and Windows apps, then largely launches the same removal routine supplied by the application itself. It does not perform the focused post-uninstall leftover scan offered by other apps listed here.
***
Whether you prefer a minimalist portable tool or a more comprehensive suite, these alternatives to the default Windows uninstall method can provide a greater level of control.
Whichever tool you choose, treat leftover detection as an informed suggestion rather than an infallible verdict. Review what will be deleted, keep a backup for important systems, and avoid cleaning the registry simply because a utility says it can.

articles.title: Un robot humanoide supera el récord humano de salto en alto: casi alcanza los tres metros
articles.text:
El robot humanoide Tien Kung, desarrollado por la empresa X-Humanoid, ejecutó un salto vertical de 2,8843 metros en la segunda edición de los Juegos Mundiales de Robots Humanoides. La marca supera el récord humano de salto en alto, que se ubica en 2,45 metros.
Este evento reúne a robots humanoides en pruebas que evalúan sus capacidades físicas y técnicas en condiciones reales. El salto de Tien Kung no fue la única actuación destacada: el mismo robot completó los 100 metros en 9,39 segundos, por debajo del récord mundial de Usain Bolt.
PUBLICIDAD
Cómo se realizó el salto
Antes de impulsarse, el robot flexionó las piernas para acumular energía y ejecutó una elevación que lo llevó a 2,8843 metros sobre el suelo, con capacidad para “realizar un split completo en el aire”, según la descripción difundida desde el evento.
Una vez en la fase aérea, mantuvo la coordinación de sus movimientos y completó el aterrizaje sin perder el equilibrio.
El control durante el despegue, vuelo y aterrizaje es lo que distingue la actuación, ya que exige una sincronización entre sensores, software y componentes mecánicos.
PUBLICIDAD
Para llegar a ese nivel, los ingenieros someten al robot a simulaciones rigurosas que contemplan la distribución de fuerza en las articulaciones, la reacción ante cambios inesperados y la absorción del impacto al regresar al suelo.
El aprendizaje automático y la optimización del movimiento son parte central del proceso.
Qué características tiene este robot
Tien Kung mide 1,7 metros de altura, cuenta con 20 grados de libertad y un torso biomimético que permite movimientos fluidos similares a los humanos.
PUBLICIDAD
Está diseñado para desplazarse a hasta 12 km/h por terrenos variados: escaleras, pendientes, arena y nieve.
Integra sensores lidar, kits de computación Nvidia Jetson Orin y manos de cinco dedos para manipulación diestra. Sus componentes de aleación de titanio le otorgan resistencia y ligereza, lo que aporta estabilidad ante impactos como empujones o golpes con peso.
PUBLICIDAD
El robot admite acceso abierto a las interfaces de control de motor, sensor y movimiento, lo que facilita la investigación y la personalización.
Para la toma de decisiones autónoma, la planificación de tareas y el control adaptativo, aprovecha la plataforma de inteligencia artificial Hui Si Kai Wu.
Robot Unitree salta 2 metros
Tien Kung no es el único robot humanoide que está redefiniendo los límites de la movilidad en los dispositivos de este tipo.
La empresa Unitree presentó recientemente un avance de uno de sus humanoides: alcanzó un salto de altura sin impulso de 2 metros y corrió con una velocidad máxima de 12,66 m/s con una longitud de pierna de 0,85 metros, marcas que superan los récords humanos en ambas disciplinas.
PUBLICIDAD
La máquina lleva poco más de tres meses en desarrollo y sus creadores señalaron que existe margen significativo para seguir mejorándola.
Unitree es también la empresa detrás de una línea de perros robot utilizados en seguridad, búsqueda y logística.
Dicho modelo pesa 12 kg, mide 0,588 × 0,22 × 0,29 metros en posición plegada y soporta una carga adaptativa de entre 3 y 5 kg.
PUBLICIDAD
Para la percepción del entorno, incorpora el sistema SSS (Super-sensing System): cinco conjuntos de sensores binoculares de profundidad ojo de pez equivalentes, según la empresa, a 20 grupos de sensores Intel RealSense, más un sensor de ojo de pez con inteligencia artificial para reconocimiento de personas.
El conjunto ofrece detección en 10 ángulos de visión. Entre sus capacidades adicionales se cuentan articulaciones flexibles y adaptativas, un sistema de acompañamiento inteligente ISS y una autonomía de larga duración, con una velocidad máxima de 17 km/h.
PUBLICIDAD
El robot camina junto a su operador humano, lo que representa una mejora sustancial respecto al modo de seguimiento convencional, indica la empresa.
PUBLICIDAD

articles.title: Google tells Android app developers to cool it on memory use, or else
articles.text:
Google will start policing memory-hungry Android apps as a direct response to the RAM crisis. Spotted by TechCrunch, the company yesterday published a memo addressing the Play Store’s role in enforcing new memory-usage restrictions. The post emphasizes the importance of meeting new memory usage limits for apps, in order “to help developers navigate industry-wide hardware constraints and Android’s broader memory limits,” it says. And failing to meet the new memory restrictions will come with consequences.
Google tells Android app developers to cool it on memory use, or else
RAMaggedon is coming for software now.
RAMaggedon is coming for software now.
The memory limitations were first introduced with Android 17, appearing first on Pixel phones. It’s probably no coincidence that the base configurations of the Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL come with less RAM than last year’s models. As Android 17 rolls out to the wider ecosystem, Google warns developers that they’ll need to play nice with a much bigger range of devices: “Over the coming year, an increasing number of manufacturers will leverage the Android per-app memory limits across their portfolio of device RAM configurations from 4GB to 16GB+ devices.”
Google has a pretty clear directive if apps misbehave: “If your app exceeds these limits, it will be slowed down and may be terminated.” But yesterday’s post hints at even bigger… ramifications (I’m so sorry): “Apps and games that do not meet these thresholds may see reduced app visibility and publishing capabilities on Google Play. Additional details will be provided later this year.” Google says it will start enforcing the memory limits in February 2027, so app makers have some time to figure it out, but dang. That’s potentially pretty serious.
The memory shortage has had a well-documented impact on hardware, and it seems that it’s time for software developers to feel the squeeze, too. And Google isn’t playing around — it seems to be putting some real teeth behind its new memory policies.

articles.title: Deepinder Goyal’s wearable startup Temple acquires London-based Longevous
articles.text:
Deepinder Goyal’s wearable startup Temple acquires London-based Longevous
As part of the acquisition, Longevous founders Dr Robert Mohr and Dr Avi Roy, along with their team, will join Temple full-time.
Deepinder Goyal-backed Temple has acquired evidence-based Longevous as it builds its clinical and scientific capabilities ahead of its launch, Goyal announced the acquisition in a post on X on Thursday.
As part of the acquisition, London-headquartered Longevous founders Dr Robert Mohr and Dr Avi Roy, along with their team, will join Temple full-time.
Mohr has been appointed Chief Medical Officer at Temple. He is a board-certified physician with nearly two decades of clinical experience and previously worked in emergency medicine before moving into evidence-based longevity medicine.
Roy has joined as Head of Science. He is an Oxford-trained biomedical scientist and has worked at the intersection of longevity science and business. He is a co-founder of Founders Health and UDA and was previously a research fellow at the Centre for the Advancement of Sustainable Medical Innovation at the University of Oxford.
According to Goyal, Mohr and Roy had been testing Temple for two months and worked with its science team to pressure-test its Entropy technology and the data it collects. They also became involved in Temple’s validation work and reviewed its first scientific manuscripts before submission.
Longevous will continue to operate as part of Temple, while Mohr and Roy will continue to look after its existing clients personally, Goyal said in his tweet.
Founded by Goyal in 2024, Temple is preparing for its launch with wearable technology to track physiological and health signals, while building an in-house science team focused on longevity.

articles.title: Panic passes Trump tariff refunds back to the Playdate customers who paid them
articles.text:
Panic, the indie game publishers behind the quirky, yellow crank-sporting Playdate gaming handheld, is issuing refunds to customers who had to shoulder the cost of inappropriate tariffs imposed by the Trump administration this year.
The news comes months after the Supreme Court said in a February ruling that those tariffs were illegal, which also demanded that the administration refund the companies that had to temporarily pay the import taxes. In an update posted on the Playdate help site this week, Panic noted that it has finally “begun to receive refunds of the tariffs we paid in the last year” and had consequently “refunded all tariffs charged to customers.”
In the initial version of that tariff note, Panic explained that it couldn’t afford to simply “absorb” the 19 percent tariffs it was being charged to import Playdate hardware made overseas because “our margins on Playdate are low.” As such, while the tax was in effect, it was passed along to customers as an explicit subtotal line item at the bottom of all Playdate orders. That’s in contrast to companies like Nintendo, which vaguely cited “market conditions” and tariff “uncertainty” in raising the asking price of legacy hardware and some Switch 2 accessories last year.
Speaking to Game Developer, Panic co-founder Cabel Sasser said filing paperwork to claw back these taxes and processing tariff refunds for customers took a fair bit of backend work. Still, he said returning that money to Playdate purchasers in the end was a no-brainer. “It’s just not our money to keep, and it felt really good to give it back,” Sasser said. “That’s an easy way to know you made the right decision.”

Perguntas frequentes sobre a linha Galaxy Book6

O que é a nova plataforma Intel Core Ultra?
A Intel Core Ultra é a nova série de processadores da Intel, sucessora das gerações Core i5, i7 e i9 tradicionais. O grande diferencial é a inclusão de uma NPU dedicada (Neural Processing Unit) — chip especializado para processar tarefas de IA localmente no notebook, sem depender de conexão à nuvem. São variações da mesma família Intel Core Ultra com posicionamentos diferentes. O Intel Core Ultra 7 355 (Galaxy Book6 IPS) é a versão padrão da linha 7 — bom equilíbrio entre desempenho e eficiência energética. O Intel Core Ultra X7 358H (Galaxy Book6 Pro) é a versão com sufixo “H” (High Performance) — maior clock, mais núcleos ativos e desempenho superior, ideal para uso profissional pesado. O Intel Core Ultra 7 356H (Galaxy Book6 Ultra) também é versão “H”, com foco em máximo desempenho combinado à placa dedicada. Para uso comum, o Ultra 7 355 atende com folga; para uso profissional intenso, os “H” valem o extra.
Tela IPS ou AMOLED: qual escolher?
São duas tecnologias de tela com posicionamentos distintos. A tela IPS (Galaxy Book6 padrão) entrega boas cores, ângulos de visão amplos e brilho adequado para uso profissional comum — atende bem trabalho, estudo, streaming e produtividade. A tela AMOLED (Galaxy Book6 Pro e Ultra) traz pretos absolutos (pixels apagados), cores mais vibrantes, contraste infinito e taxa de atualização geralmente superior. Para criadores de conteúdo, editores de vídeo e designers, AMOLED é a escolha certa; para uso profissional intenso sem foco em criação visual, IPS entrega excelente experiência por preço menor.

A NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 é da nova série 50 (arquitetura Blackwell), com desempenho significativamente superior à RTX 4060 anterior, suporte a DLSS 4 (frame generation por IA otimizada) e melhor eficiência energética. Combinada com tela AMOLED 16″ touch, Intel Core Ultra 7 356H e Galaxy AI, entrega estação de trabalho móvel completa. É indicado para edição profissional de vídeo em 4K, renderização 3D (arquitetura, engenharia), gaming pesado e uso científico com CUDA. Vale a pena a tela touch em notebook?
Depende do uso. A tela touch (presente nos Galaxy Book6 Pro e Ultra) é diferencial forte para criadores de conteúdo (anotação com caneta, desenho, ilustração), profissionais que fazem apresentações (interação direta), estudantes que fazem anotações manuscritas e uso em modo tablet (quando o notebook tem construção 2 em 1). Para uso puramente com teclado e mouse (produtividade tradicional), a tela touch é diferencial secundário — vale mais o investimento em RAM ou SSD se o orçamento for limitado.

articles.title: Android-Handys sollen bald PCs ausschalten können
articles.text:
Für Android-Smartphones: Microsoft soll an Fernsteuerung für Windows-11-PC arbeiten
Schon länger arbeitet Microsoft daran, Windows-11-Computer und Smartphones enger zu verbinden. Insbesondere Android-Nutzer:innen profitieren von der App Smartphone-Link, die direkten Zugriff auf das Smartphone und eine Reihe von dessen Funktionen erlaubt. Aber auch in puncto iPhone schreitet die Verzahnung voran.
Windows 11 rückt näher an Android
Anfang August 2026 war bekannt geworden, dass im Startmenü von Windows 11 bald der Inhalt von Android-Benachrichtigungen angezeigt werden soll, wie giga.de schreibt. Für das iPhone ist demnach immerhin eine geräteübergreifende Zwischenablage, mit der sich Inhalte vom iPhone auf den Windows-PC übertragen lassen sollen, in Sicht.
Android-Nutzer:innen könnte derweil bald eine Art Fernsteuerung für ihren Windows-11-Rechner zur Verfügung stehen. Entsprechenden Code haben die Kolleg:innen von Windows Latest in einer Testversion von Link to Windows entdeckt, der Android-Begleit-App für Microsofts Smartphone-Link.
Per Fernzugriff den PC abschalten
Demnach ließen sich per Android-Handy entsprechend gekoppelte PCs mit Windows 11 aus der Ferne ausschalten, neustarten oder in den Ruhezustand versetzen. Praktisch wäre das vor allem, wenn man beim Verlassen des Büros vergessen haben sollte, den Computer auszuschalten. Auch Updates sollen sich mit der neuen Funktion anstoßen lassen. Schon jetzt können Android-Nutzer:innen per Link to Windows ihren PC aus der Ferne sperren.
Die neuen Fernsteuerungsoptionen sollen den Code-Informationen zufolge auch Mitteilungen an das Smartphone auslösen. So könnten Nutzer:innen darüber eine Warnung erhalten, dass im Falle des Abschaltens des PCs nicht gespeicherte Daten verlorengehen könnten.
Nach dem Abschalten händisch starten
Ein kleiner Haken. Wer seinen PC per Android-Handy aus der Ferne abschaltet, hat anschließend keine Möglichkeit mehr diesen auch per Fernsteuerung wieder zu starten. Das muss man dann händisch erledigen. Der Grund dafür ist, dass beim Abschalten auch die Verbindung zwischen Smartphone und Computer gekappt wird.
Ob und wann die neuen Funktionen in die Link-to-Windows-App einfließen, ist nicht klar. Microsoft hat dazu bisher keine offizielle Ankündigung veröffentlicht. Ebenfalls unklar ist, ob eine solche Möglichkeit irgendwann auch iPhone-Nutzer:innen zur Verfügung stehen soll.

articles.title: Canadian platforms shouldn’t offer sports or entertainment prediction market bets, regulators say | BetaKit
articles.text:
Regulated prediction markets in Canada shouldn’t be able to offer sports or entertainment contracts as securities, according to a statement issued by the nation’s securities regulators.
The news: The Canadian Securities Administrators (CSA) and the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO) published a joint notice on Thursday saying that contracts relating to sports and entertainment events should not be regulated as securities or derivatives, and that CIRO won’t allow its members to offer these types of contracts.
In Canada, regulated contract dealers (currently Wealthsimple and Interactive Brokers) under CIRO can offer event contracts related to economic indicators, climate-related events, and financial markets.CSA and CIRO said in their joint release that other types of event contracts are still being assessed.
From the source: “I definitely understand CIRO’s logic here: sports and entertainment outcomes are hard to regulate and look much more like gaming than securities,” Noah Billick, a partner at Montréal law firm Renno & Co, wrote in a LinkedIn post. “My concern is this: given the interconnected world we live in, and the ease with which Canadian residents can access prediction markets that are not regulated in Canada, is this simply going to push Canadians into less-regulated, shadowy corners of the prediction markets space?”
The context: The statement from regulators comes shortly after Wealthsimple, which launched a prediction markets app this summer, argued in a whitepaper that dividing up the regulatory oversight of derivatives instruments by subject matter is the “wrong approach” for regulators. For instance, Wealthsimple’s paper said, putting sports outcomes under gaming regulation while financial outcomes are treated as securities would be “unworkable.” In response to a request for comment on CSA and CIRO’s statement today, Wealthsimple referred BetaKit to the whitepaper.
Final thought: While sports and entertainment event contracts won’t be permitted by CIRO for now, Wealthsimple is still teasing the offering: its app displays some of these markets, such as trades on Academy Award nominations, with a feature to notify the user once it becomes available in Canada.
Regulation for these markets is up in the air elsewhere, too. More than 20 US states have sued prediction market operators like Kalshi and Polymarket over whether they should be subject to state laws on sports gambling.
Disclosure: Wealthsimple vice-president of payments strategy and chief compliance officer, Hanna Zaidi, sits on BetaKit’s board of directors.
Feature image courtesy Wealthsimple.

articles.title: Probamos Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls y es el juego de peleas ideal para una noche con amigos
articles.text:
Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls es una propuesta interesante como juego de peleas. El exclusivo de PlayStation es una experiencia intermedia entre un videojuego competitivo y uno casual, que visualmente impacta y encaja perfectamente en el plan de pelear con amigos y combinar elementos estratégicos.
Durante varias semanas tuvimos la oportunidad de probar este lanzamiento, así que traemos nuestra opinión de un juego que generó mucha expectativa por su atractivo apartado visual y porque está desarrollado por Arc System Works, los mismos de Dragon Ball FighterZ, varios de la saga Guilty Gear y más juegos de lucha reconocidos.
PUBLICIDAD
Qué ofrece Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls
Este es un juego orientado a un público variado. Si bien su paquete de contenido apunta a estar más cerca del usuario casual, a medida que ingresamos a las partidas nos damos cuenta del componente estratégico que tiene y de cómo la combinación de personajes es clave para saber desarrollar cada enfrentamiento.
Tōkon consiste en luchas de 4 vs. 4 en las que los tres personajes que no son los “protagonistas temporales” del combate están entrando y saliendo para realizar golpes y combos.
PUBLICIDAD
Al contar con la licencia de Marvel, tendremos a los principales personajes de los cómics: Iron Man, Capitán América, Spiderman, Wolverine, Tormenta, Dr. Doom... Aunque el listado inicial es corto, de apenas 20, los desarrolladores aseguran que llegarán más en el futuro.
Este contenido le da al juego la oportunidad de profundizar en los modos offline y online de manera diferente. Lo primero será un modo de episodios en el que tendremos una misma historia base, pero que podemos vivir desde cuatro perspectivas diferentes, con una narrativa muy similar a los cómics y en la que tendremos combates rápidos para derrotar a un villano final.
PUBLICIDAD
Un modo interesante para aprender a jugar, aunque se siente muy fugaz, ya que las peleas son cortas y lo realmente llamativo es ver las viñetas ir y venir.
La mejor parte del contenido está lejos de ese modo. Por un lado, tenemos el modo All Star Arena, también offline, en el que debemos enfrentar una serie de equipos mientras vamos adquiriendo habilidades y la dificultad va aumentando.
PUBLICIDAD
También está el Arcadia Rumble, en el que, junto a otros 8 jugadores, estaremos inicialmente en un mini mundo abierto realizando minijuegos para ganar puntos y luego habrá enfrentamientos para seguir sumando en la tabla general. Luego, el modo supervivencia, donde contaremos con una sola barra de vida para ver cuántos duelos podemos ganar consecutivamente.
Y, finalmente, los modos más tradicionales de versus online y offline, para jugar con amigos.
Cómo se sienten las peleas con personajes de Marvel
Como sucede en estos juegos, la variedad de personajes no es algo meramente estético. Cada héroe o villano se siente diferente, unos son más pesados que otros, algunos rápidos para ejecutar combos o requieren de mayor repetición para comprenderlos.
PUBLICIDAD
Pero, en general, los combates de Marvel Tōkon son sencillos en lo básico. Quizás lo más complejo es aprender a manejar los compañeros de equipo que entran y salen, además de todo lo relacionado con la estrategia profunda de cada personaje: combos, ritmo, debilidades y sinergia con los demás.
En la práctica, este juego no requiere de horas y horas de estudio para disfrutarlo. Es ideal para una noche de juegos con amigos, en la que cualquiera puede aprender a manejar un personaje con facilidad para pasarla bien.
PUBLICIDAD
Al mismo tiempo, es posible dedicarse al estudio profundo para tener un plan de juego estructurado, especialmente en aquellos modos de juego más complejos en los que se agregan habilidades y se va subiendo de nivel. Por lo que es un punto medio antes de entrar al nivel competitivo como Tekken 8 o Street Fighter 6.
Al tratarse de un juego de peleas por equipos, el manejo de los tres compañeros de combate (que, de igual forma, pueden entrar a tomar el protagonismo de la pelea) es algo fundamental de entender. Esta es una parte muy disfrutable del juego, porque los combos no son difíciles de ejecutar una vez se memorizan, y la variedad de personajes es ideal para tener compañeros que brinden diferentes tipos de apoyo.
PUBLICIDAD
¿Vale o no la pena Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls?
Esta reseña fue hecha con una versión de PlayStation 5, en la que no hubo ningún problema de rendimiento. Sin embargo, los reportes de PC no son positivos y eso puede alejar a muchos usuarios.
Pero lo que ofrece Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls es una experiencia ideal para quien no se considera un usuario competitivo de este tipo de juegos, sino que busca una experiencia casual para tener en casa cuando sus amigos o familiares lo visiten.
PUBLICIDAD
Al mismo tiempo, el paquete de contenido es bastante amplio como para dedicarle unas buenas horas y entender la complejidad que ofrece, con modos de juego variados, un estilo visual espectacular, doblaje al español latino y la promesa de más contenido a futuro. Un exclusivo de PlayStation que cumple.
PUBLICIDAD
PUBLICIDAD

articles.title: Speedo’s new smart goggles module can track all four swim strokes
articles.text:
Speedo is launching a removable smart module for its Vanquisher goggles that can analyze a swimmer’s performance across all four swim strokes: freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, and butterfly. The new Speedo iQ system uses swim-specific sensors to analyze head movement in the water, time breaths, and track distance per stroke.
Speedo’s new smart goggles module can track all four swim strokes
A removable Speedo iQ module tracks swim strokes, head movement, breaths, distance, and more.
Unlike other smart goggles, such as those from Form, Speedo’s iQ system doesn’t come with a built-in display. Instead, the Speedo iQ module automatically transmits data to its accompanying app, allowing swimmers to see their performance when they get out of the water. Additionally, Speedo notes that you can simply transfer the module to another pair of Vanquisher goggles if they need to be replaced.
The Speedo iQ system doesn’t require a subscription, and it’s also legal to use during World Aquatics competitions. The Vanquisher goggles with the iQ module included cost $189. They’re available to order now in a variety of colors.

articles.title: Australian police arrest two over TeamPCP hacks targeting Mercor, OpenAI, and others | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Australian police have arrested two people in Perth accused of being members of TeamPCP, a prolific hacking group blamed for high-profile hacks against big tech giants in recent months. The two have been charged with more than a dozen hacking, money laundering, and other cybercrime offenses and are expected in court later on Thursday.
According to a statement by the Australian Federal Police, the two men are accused of widespread breaches involving the compromise and tampering of popular open source projects. The hackers aimed to infect a large number of computers to steal credentials and data, then extort victims into paying a ransom.
The FBI’s cyber division chief Brett Leatherman was quoted as saying that the two alleged members of TeamPCP are accused of hacking into more than a thousand organizations as part of their attacks.
It’s unclear whether the Justice Department plans to seek extradition, and a spokesperson for the FBI did not comment when contacted by TechCrunch.
TeamPCP is a prolific cybercriminal gang known for several widespread hacking campaigns targeting the software supply chain, in which the hackers would break in and maliciously modify a popular open source software tool used by potentially thousands of companies.
Once installed on a company’s or developer’s systems, the malicious code steals their private keys and other sensitive credentials used to access cloud storage systems and, oftentimes, customer data. The authorities said the hackers stole more than half a million credentials to further their attacks into other companies.
The hackers were blamed for a cyberattack on the popular vulnerability scanner tool Trivy, which affected any company that relied on it, including LiteLLM, AI recruiting startup Mercor, and others. The hackers are also suspected of breaching the European Commission’s cloud infrastructure, as well as targeting other open source projects and developer apps that allowed access to tech giants like GitHub and OpenAI.
The Australian officials said their investigations began in April 2026 after receiving information from multiple cybersecurity companies.
Police have not named the men who were arrested, but independent cybersecurity journalist Brian Krebs exclusively reported that one of the now-arrested alleged hackers is Ruben Thomson, who goes by the hacker handle Ellis. Krebs reported Thursday that he was in contact with Ellis over the past several months, and the hacker told Krebs that he was the leader of TeamPCP until March 2026.
Krebs said Ellis made mistakes that allowed the journalist to learn the alleged hacker’s real identity.
During a press conference on Wednesday announcing the arrests, Australian officials said they had also seized a large quantity of allegedly stolen data, as well as devices and other electronics from the hackers. The officials said they planned to notify victims of the attacks.

articles.title: Microsoft está agotando su nuevo mando con el que celebra el 25 aniversario de Xbox. Aquí puedes intentar hacerte con él
articles.text:
No es el mejor momento para comprar hardware, mucho menos gaming, teniendo en cuenta que las principales videoconsolas del momento (PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2 y Xbox Series) no dejan de subir más y más de precio. Pero el hecho de que el mercado esté viviendo un auténtico caos de precios y stock no evita que las compañías sigan lanzando nuevos dispositivos a la venta... a unos precios no aptos para todos los bolsillos en muchos casos, eso sí.
En este sentido, Microsoft, que este 2026 está celebrando el 25 aniversario de Xbox, acaba de lanzar la nueva Xbox Series X25 y la X25 Edición Especial de su mando de última generación. Ambos, con un genial diseño translúcido en tonos verdes en la línea de aquellos dispositivos que vivieron una auténtica época dorada en las décadas de los noventa y los dosmil.
Xbox Mando inalámbrico X25 Special Edition Series X|S
Dicho mando ya está disponible en España para reservar a través de la tienda oficial de Microsoft, desde hoy mismo, aunque con un gran pero: el stock disponible vuela y la propia Microsoft remite directamente a diferentes canales de venta de distribuidores de Xbox como Amazon, MediaMarkt, Game, Fnac y xtralife, entre tantas otras tiendas, porque aparece agotado en la de Xbox.
Sin embargo, en Amazon aparece disponible desde hace unos minutos a su PVP de 79,99 euros (aunque no sabemos cuánto durará). De modo que si nos damos prisa podemos reservarlo antes de que se agote aquí también.
Con un PVP de 79,99 euros y una fecha de lanzamiento prevista en octubre
Tal y como anunció la propia Microsoft, ya están abiertas las reservas para este nuevo mando. El cual tiene un precio de 79,99 euros y una ventana de lanzamiento prevista para el 20 de octubre, fecha a partir de la que los afortunados que lleguen a hacerse con uno comenzarán a recibirlo. Por el momento, sólo podemos reservarlo.
En esencia, estamos ante un mando similar al resto de modelos básicos de Microsoft en cuando a funciones y especificaciones. Entre las que se incluye algunas mejoras respecto a generaciones pasadas en la cruceta, los gatillos o el botón share dedicado, pensado para compartir contenido al momento mientras jugamos.
Todo ello, con una compatibilidad multiplataforma entre PC, equipos Mac, tablets, teléfonos y mucho más. Además de una conectividad inalámbrica y una ergonomía que hacen del mando de Microsoft para Xbox Series uno de los mejores en relación calidad precio del mercado. Pero con claras diferencias en su diseño, como la botonera con colores originales de Xbox, el logotipo de los 25 años de la marca, el plástico translúcido y más.

articles.title: Streamlining 3D-IC Design: Substrate, Finalization, And Tapeout
articles.text:
Effective substrate implementation is crucial for signal integrity, power delivery, and overall system reliability.
By Keith Felton and Todd Burkholder
The superior performance, functionality, and smaller form factors of 3D-ICs are propelling advances in the semiconductor industry. Unlike traditional 2D-ICs, 3D-ICs vertically stack multiple active device layers connected with through-silicon vias. This vertical integration delivers many benefits but introduces further complexity in design and manufacturing, particularly in substrate implementation, design finalization, and fabrication tapeout.
In the first two articles in this series (published in this journal in June and July), we covered the first four steps toward streamlining the 3D-IC design process. With these steps completed, the design team is ready to perform substrate implementation strategies, finalize the substrate design, and tapeout the fabrication mask set. We will examine these steps in this article.
The substrate forms the foundation of any 3D-IC design, acting as the integration platform for chiplets, memory, and interposers. Effective substrate implementation is crucial for signal integrity, power delivery, and overall system reliability.
The implementation process starts by importing a carefully floorplanned design scenario and a thoroughly validated system netlist. This netlist should have undergone predictive multiphysics analysis to prevent potential issues. In a streamlined 3D-IC workflow, the optimized design scenario is developed using the specialized Siemens Innovator3D IC Integrator software and is forward-annotated into the Innovator3D IC Layout substrate implementation tool, thus ensuring continuity and accuracy all the way from planning to layout.
Fig. 1: Signal path “sketch plan” proposals as defined in Innovator3D IC Integrator.
The next step is to load the specific substrate technology rules, provided by the substrate supplier or foundry/OSAT. In traditional IC design, these rules are delivered as process design kits (PDKs) along with the design rule manual. For 3D-IC package design, PDKs are still evolving, but many foundries and Tier 1 OSATs offer digital design data as assembly design kits or package assembly design kits. The emerging IEEE 3Dblox file also defines a modular syntax for describing components and their connectivity. Regardless of the format, this data must be accurately loaded into the physical implementation tool for correct-by-construction design.
With all design data and technology rules loaded, the next step is finalizing the substrate/interposer power delivery network (PDN). If the initial design scenario was comprehensively floorplanned using a pathfinding and prototyping tool, the imported scenario likely contains prototyped PDNs. These preliminary PDNs require meticulous finalization to comply with the fabricator’s detailed design rules, including verifying space for micro-bump and bump breakout patterns, and sufficient signal routing channels. It’s often necessary to replace simpler prototype via structures with more complex, fabrication-ready ones.
Fig. 2: Chiplet-to-chiplet interface pin field breakout routing using Innovator3D IC Layout’s embedded interface routing automation.
Heterogeneously integrated designs often incorporate multiple channels, allowing for circuit and route pattern replication. This technique shortens design cycles and enhances efficiency, as changes to a master (“seed”) pattern automatically propagate to all replicated instances. High-bandwidth memory arrays are prime candidates for such replication. While a simple copy-paste method can be used, it requires manual updates for each pasted instance if changes are needed.
A more efficient approach uses substrate design tools supporting intelligent circuit replication, often via physical reuse blocks. With this capability, a seed instance is identified and replicated, maintaining a vital link to the original. If connectivity or assignment changes are necessary, updating the seed propagates these changes to all or selected instances, significantly reducing design time and potential errors.
Route plans, established by the Innovator3D IC Integrator pathfinding and prototyping cockpit, suggest signal and interface paths for connectivity. These preliminary plans, however, require meticulous tuning to accommodate the detailed substrate design spacing rules provided by the fabricator.
The initial phase of this detailed interconnect routing focuses on completing critical interfaces, typically between logic devices and memory and between logic devices themselves. The most challenging aspect often involves successfully routing signals into and out of the micro-bump pin fields of chiplets and HBM devices to external connections. Routing real estate frequently necessitates complex shielded via arrays for differential signals. The efficiency of this process is significantly enhanced because Innovator3D IC Integrator can automatically create complex via arrays and store them as library elements for reuse.
After critical replicated circuitry and interface routing are finalized, the remaining connectivity routing can be completed through manual, automatic, or semi-automatic methods. Many designers prefer a semi-automatic approach, balancing automation and user control. Tools with “sketch router” capabilities, for instance, offer multiple modes and options to precisely control route flow, from one-button automation to user-defined path specifications. Innovator3D IC Integrator features like push, shove, and hug modes intelligently manipulate route segments around and over objects, such as vias or device pads, optimizing routing efficiency and adherence to design rules.
Fig. 3: Semi-automated routing using the sketch router.
Before design can proceed to tapeout, it is necessary to finalize the substrate design, ensuring it meets fabrication requirements and addressing potential manufacturing challenges. These steps include optimizing the PDN, adding essential fiducial markers, and preparing the design for thermal and mask design rule check (DRC) signoff.
Following PDN structure finalization, the focus shifts to optimizing the PDN for fabrication yield and reliability. PDNs are typically large metal-filled areas (“metal pours”). Such extensive metal areas can cause fabrication issues like outgassing, where gas bubbles form during manufacturing and can lead to layer delamination and substrate warping. This can be mitigated by inserting degassing voids within these metal areas. Substrate fabricators provide rules for these voids, which vary in size and shape and are inserted in areas exceeding a certain dimension. This process, if manual, can be tedious; however, dedicated substrate design tools, like Innovator3D IC Layout, offer utilities for multi-pass degassing void insertion, allowing selection of void shapes and sizes that meet fabricator requirements and can intelligently avoid inserting voids under differential signals to prevent timing issues.
Fig. 4: Innovator3D IC Layout degassing void insertion utility.
After degassing is complete, the next step is metal balancing. After PDN planes are finalized and degassed, the metal ratio across design layers can become non-uniform, leading to substrate warpage during fabrication or package assembly. To counteract this, tools calculate metal density by redistribution layers (RDL) and by defined area for each RDL layer. If an RDL layer is within the fabricator’s overall metal density range, attention then shifts to individual areas. If an area has excessive metal, additional degassing voids can be inserted. Conversely, if there is insufficient metal, necessary dummy metal fill for deficient areas can be created, ensuring compliance with fabricator requirements. These metal blocks are then re-imported into the design.
Fiducial markers enable operators and automated systems to quickly determine a particular location within the die, which is essential for high-magnification microscopy, micro-probing, or failure analysis. Fiducial markers are distinct, identifiable structures embedded within a die or interposer/substrate. They serve as crucial reference points for locating, aligning, and navigating during various stages of testing, inspection, and de-processing. These markers are essential for accurate fabrication and assembly of multi-chiplet 2.5/3D-IC package designs.
Fig. 5: Dedicated fiducial marker object within Innovator3D IC Layout.
Adding top and bottom die fiducials allows internal-layer, buried dies to be aligned during the manufacturing and assembly process. Additionally, top and bottom metal layer fiducials can be used during the alignment of stacked dies. Historically, fiducial markers were often created manually, a time-consuming and error-prone process. Innovator3D IC Layout, however, features dedicated, intelligent design object classes for fiducial markers, allowing them to be stored, reused, and shared efficiently across designs.
It is imperative to conduct early predictive thermal analysis during the pathfinding and prototyping stages. Issues detected at this time are typically easier and less costly to address. Neglecting predictive analysis can lead to major challenges during the detailed design stage, significantly increasing mitigation efforts. Even with early thermal analysis, there is still a need for final detailed sign-off thermal analysis. To streamline this process, robust integration between the package physical design tool and the thermal analysis solution is crucial for efficient data exchange and accurate simulation.
Fig. 6: Calibre 3DThermal is directly integrated with Innovator3D IC Layout.
Before the substrate/interposer mask set can be taped out for fabrication, it must achieve DRC signoff using the fabricator’s PDK. This signoff DRC is typically performed not within the layout tool itself, but in a separate graphical Boolean-based verification tool, using the actual mask set data that will be sent to the fabricator. The fabricator’s PDK is almost universally provided in a format compatible with industry-standard DRC tools, such as Calibre, which address all sign-off requirements. Because Calibre is the industry standard, the consumed mask set can be exported from all substrate/integrator design tools.
Fig. 7: Calibre DRC viewer/explorer.
With the mask set loaded into the DRC tool along with the design rules, results are quickly available, allowing designers to address any identified issues. The advantage of using Innovator3D IC Layout with Calibre is that the Calibre DRC results-viewer is directly integrated. This enables any DRC issues detected by Calibre to be highlighted directly in the Innovator3D IC Layout editor, making debugging a much easier process.
Fig. 8: Calibre DRC results viewer is directly integrated with Innovator3D IC Layout.
After all DRC issues have been thoroughly addressed or formally waived, the designer can create the production mask set, typically in GDSII or the more compact OASIS format. It is often required, and always highly recommended, to re-validate the design using the DRC tool to ensure it is “clean” and that no new issues were inadvertently introduced during mask issue resolution. A clean DRC report signals that the mask set is ready to be sent to the fabricator.
This marks the completion of the detailed design implementation phase, and we are on to our next article in this series, in which we will see why embracing robust data management practices, including diligent management of the design and its design IP sources, meticulous revision control, centralized information hubs, and comprehensive status tracking for traceability, lays a solid foundation for success.
To dive deeper into on how to improve your 3D-IC flow, please check out the new series of eBooks from Siemens on Streamlining 3D-IC design:
Todd Burkholder is a senior editor at Siemens DISW. For over 25 years, he has worked as editor, author, and ghost writer with internal and external customers to create print and digital content across a broad range of EDA technologies. Burkholder began his career in marketing for high-technology and other industries in 1992 after earning a Bachelor of Science at Portland State University and a Master of Science degree from the University of Arizona.

articles.title: Traders brought Central American cacao to Georgia 1,000 years ago
articles.text:
A thousand years ago, feasts in what’s now northern Georgia state included cacao from Central America.
Potsherds discarded after an 11th-century feast at Etowah—an Indigenous city just north of what’s now Atlanta—contained traces of cacao, a raw ingredient of chocolate. The chemical residue and ancient DNA reveal that not only did the Mississippian people who built the city have excellent taste, they also had trade connections that reached at least 3,000 kilometers to Central America. And in a sense, chocolate may have helped build the Mississippian mounds.
Ancient dirty dishes
University of South Carolina archaeologist Adam King and his colleagues found fragments of ancient DNA from Theobroma cacao in the inner surfaces of potsherds from long-ago feasts at Etowah. Fruit from the cacao tree contains beans that, when dried and roasted, produce chocolate in all its glorious forms. Cacao only grows in the tropics, which means the nearest actual cacao trees would have been at least a 3,000-kilometer trek away from the woodlands of the eastern US. And that means the Mississippian people who lived in Etowah must have had continent-spanning trade connections.
Etowah was a major center of the Mississippian culture, which flourished in the southeastern US in the centuries before colonization. By 1350 CE, wooden palisades and guard towers ringed a trio of giant earthen mounds (and three smaller ones), the largest of which stood six stories high and covered three acres. Log temples atop the mounds overlooked wide plazas for ball games, ceremonies, and open-air markets. The feast that King and his colleagues studied dates to two centuries before Etowah’s heyday, during the building of the first big platform mound.
After digging up a huge quantity of dirt for that mound (a 19-meter-high mound with a base area of three acres has a volume of… math), people filled in a pit with refuse from community feasts, including a lot of broken pottery, much to the delight of future archaeologists, who categorically love broken pottery. And because nobody washed the dishes before tossing them into the feasting pit, King and his colleagues (in a 2017 study) could analyze the microscopic residue of ancient drinks that had soaked into the ceramic.

articles.title: Nuevo Galaxy S26 FE: Samsung lleva lo mejor del S26 Ultra y del Galaxy Z Fold 8 a un modelo más económico que vas a querer sí o sí
articles.text:
La familia Galaxy S26 tiene un nuevo miembro más económico, pero con prestaciones muy similares a las de sus hermanos mayores. Samsung ha presentado oficialmente el Galaxy S26 FE, una versión especial que llega con las funciones estrella del resto de modelos de la familia y con alguna que otra sorpresa heredada de los últimos plegables de Samsung.
El nuevo Galaxy S26 FE, de hecho, no solo hereda algunas de las especificaciones clave de los modelos más potentes de la marca: también llega con un diseño muy similar. El móvil de Samsung cuenta con esa estética tan característica de los móviles de la marca, con una parte trasera completamente plana y un sistema de triple cámara colocado en posición vertical, que hace que el diseño se vea limpio a la par que elegante.
El frontal, por su parte, está equipado por una pantalla Dynamic AMOLED 2X de 6,7 pulgadas con resolución Full HD+ y una tasa de refresco adaptativa de hasta 120 Hz. Todo ello, con un brillo de 1.900 nits y una batería de 4.900 mAh con una carga rápida de 45W y carga inalámbrica de 15W.
Respecto al rendimiento, el Galaxy S26 FE llega con un procesador Exynos 2500 acompañado con 8 GB de memoria RAM y diferentes versiones de almacenamiento interno, con 128, 256 o 512 GB.
Así es la cámara del Galaxy S26 FE
Uno de los puntos más interesantes del Galaxy S26 FE es, sin duda, su apartado fotográfico. El nuevo móvil de Samsung está equipado con una cámara principal de 50 megapíxeles y una apertura f/1.8. Le acompaña una cámara ultra gran angular de 12 megapíxeles y una cámara teleobjetivo de 8 megapíxeles de resolución, que es capaz de tomar fotografías con un zoom óptico 3x y un digital de hasta 30x.
Por si fuera poco, la compañía ha añadido esas funciones tan especiales que llegaron con los Galaxy S26 y que también incluyen los nuevos plegables de la marca. Una de ellas es la función de My FanCam, hasta ahora exclusiva de los Galaxy Z Fold 8. Esta hace que la cámara sea capaz de seguir a una persona seleccionada y mantenerla en todo momento centrada, incluso aunque haga movimientos o desplazamientos rápidos. El sistema es capaz de ajustar el encuadre de forma inteligente y dependiendo de la escena.
El Galaxy S26 FE también hereda la función Super Steady que debutó con los Galaxy S26 más potentes y que permite estabilizar al completo la cámara para vídeos mucho más fluidos. Por último, el móvil de Samsung también recibe funciones como Photo Assist, para modificar o ajustar imágenes con la ayuda de la IA mediante una descripción de texto, o Nightography, que permite capturar fotos luminosas en situaciones de baja luz.
Con One UI 9 de serie
Por si fuera poco, el Galaxy S26 FE debuta con One UI 9, la versión más reciente de la capa de personalización de Samsung que incluye funciones como Now Brief, una sección con información relevante que ahora se puede personalizar a medida. También llega con Now Nudge, que permite activar accesos directos a secciones del sistema, como el calendario o correos o diferentes sugerencias dependiendo del contexto.
Samsung, además, ha confirmado que el Galaxy S26 FE cuenta con hasta siete generaciones de actualizaciones del sistema operativo y siete años de actualizaciones de seguridad, lo que garantiza que recibirá futuras versiones de One UI 9 más adelante.
¿Cuándo cuesta el Galaxy S26 FE?
El nuevo smartphone de Samsung saldrá a la venta el próximo 4 de septiembre a un precio de partida de 799 euros para la versión de 8 GB de RAM y 128 GB de almacenamiento interno. Está disponible en colores arándano (azulado), pistacho (verde) y grafito (negro).

articles.title: Nvidia wants to buy Hugging Face in $13 billion blockbuster AI deal
articles.text:
Nvidia wants to buy Hugging Face in $13 billion blockbuster AI deal
Nvidia reportedly set to close $13 billion Hugging Face deal
- Nvidia is reportedly preparing to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9bn
- A 2023 investment round valued the company at $4.5bn
- Nvidia is on a roll of investing heavily in other companies
Nvidia has reportedly spent the past couple of weeks actively engaging with Hugging Face to explore an acquisition deal worth an estimated $12.9 billion, according to Business Insider reporting, citing an unnamed source familiar with the matter.
To date, the companies are yet to reach an agreement, but with the current valuation speculations, it would make a Hugging Face acquisition one of Nvidia's largest acquisitions to date.
Importantly, this wouldn't be the chipmaker's first run-in with Hugging Face – it took part in a $235 million funding round in 2023. At that time, Hugging Face's valuation was around $4.5 billion - making today's valuation nearly three times higher.
Nvidia and Hugging Face
While this may be one of Nvidia's biggest acquisitions to date, it's just one of a growing number, as the company recently admitted it had $18 billion committed to equity investments for the rest of the financial year, and it already holds $47.9 billion in private company stock.
However, there's still a shadow over the potential Nvidia acquisition, with Hugging Face previously turning down a $500 million Nvidia investment over concerns that a single shareholder could have such a big influence.
The high valuation also makes the prospective acquisition a costly one – at around 86x Hugging Face's annualized revenue ($150 million), Nvidia would be paying a premium for the platform's strategic position and existing relationships, against a backdrop of ongoing investments in models and development tools.
Regulator scrutiny might also question whether competing chipmakers and cloud service providers could be put at a disadvantage, particularly if Nvidia imposes hardware and software restrictions on the platform after a takeover.

articles.title: 10 Browser-Based Tools That Can Save You Time Every Day - Tech Guide
articles.text:
You have recently been promoted to a managerial position, and you are more overwhelmed than happy by the multitasking and extended responsibilities.
“With great power comes great responsibility”. Does the Spider-Man dialogue feel personal now? You might be thinking, Spider-Man had a gift, but you got none! How would you manage all the tasks single-handedly?
You might not have Spidey-sense, but you have browser-based web tools in rescue.
You never get disorganized with big tasks or bigger decision-making. It is the everyday tiny chores that you will get scattered with.
Tasks such as note-taking, writing emails and reports, scheduling meetings, managing PDF files, and other everyday manual tasks drain a significant amount of your time, taking your concentration and energy away from more important tasks.
These browser-based tools magically help you manage all these tasks and mitigate your everyday workload.
Here are ten browser-based tools that can save you time on repetitive chores.
AI Writing Tools
AI writing tools are perhaps the most essential web tools that any kind of job requires.
Whether you are a designated job holder, an entrepreneur, or a freelancer, you need to write emails, reports, documentation, content, and other relevant papers every day. So, writing is a basic requirement in any workspace scenario.
To make writing easy, there are abundant effective AI writing tools that can impressively create all sorts of writing pieces for you.
For better results, there are other tools to fine-tune and polish the writing pieces that you may use, such as an AI detector, an AI humanizer tool, and a plagiarism checker.
These tools help you find the glitches and scope to improve the writing piece when it is a bigger or more important document. So, these tools will effectively reduce your time spent writing and improving your emails, reports, documentation, and content.
Grammar Corrector
As we are talking about writing different content and documents, grammar correction comes next.
Since you have to write a lot within a short duration of time every day, there are lots of silly grammar mistakes or typos that may go unnoticed while writing.
A grammar correction tool helps you fix grammar mistakes, spelling errors, punctuation, gaps, and typos. These tools also give suggestions for better clarity and coherence. So to speak, these tools improve your writing pieces in a few minutes, saving your time for more creative writing.
On some platforms, you have to upload your document or copy-paste your text, and they will provide the corrected form of the text. Some of them allow you to have a Chrome extension, which keeps correcting your text while you are writing in Docs, Gmail, or even in chat boxes.
So, a grammar correction browser-based tool can change your everyday work life into an easy-breezy one.
PDF Management Tools
Another frequently done task in an organization is compressing, merging, and converting PDFs, which takes unnecessary time.
In an organization, people frequently need to convert or merge contracts, cover letters, reports, and appointment letters. And almost every department needs to do this kind of task.
Some web browsers compress PDF files to make them portable, merge them into a single clean file, convert them into different forms, and even split them according to your requirements.
These tools also let you edit them, put a digital signature on them, and insert images into them.
So, you must use a PDF management web tool to manage your PDF files and keep them organized in different formats when you need them.
Time Management Tools
In our workspace, most of our time is consumed by distractions and mindless browsing.
So, time management becomes a big issue for functioning properly in offices. For that, there are some tools that you can add to your Chrome extension, like grammar correction tools.
These tools track your web activities, show your daily web browsing duration, and the websites where you are investing most of your time. The tools even block distractions and give you an alert when you try to browse social media.
So, a time management tool might be the thing you really want at this moment.
Project Management Tools
Project management tools are lifesavers for those who have to handle multiple tasks at the same time.
These tools make your work life easy by organizing your repetitive daily tasks, tracking regular progress and sales, streamlining communications, and collaborating with different teams.
These types of web browsers help users by distributing and assigning tasks, tracking deadlines, managing project databases, and reporting into a single dashboard. It helps you to keep every employee in the loop for a particular project.
So, a project management tool will not only save your time in the workspace, but it will also improve your workflow.
Note-taking Tools
Note-taking is another crucial task that we do on a daily basis, which requires more time than needed. On top of that, manual note-taking may skip some important information, especially when you are in a meeting.
This is where a note-taking tool comes in. These tools keep all the necessary notes in an organized way by capturing data figures, retrieving ideas, meeting details, pointing out important information, and summarizing the discussion.
So, note-taking tools can effectively help while reducing your time investment and effort.
To-do List Maker
A to-do list maker tool may sound unnecessary at the beginning. But if you are working on a big project, you will definitely want one.
Sometimes, some tiny tasks may slip your mind that are necessary and crucial. For example, sending a small but important email to a client or publishing an important notice or announcement.
A web-based to-do list maker automatically captures your tasks, assignments, and deadlines and notes them down as your to-do list regularly. Also, the tools give you a reminder on the specific date and time so that you never forget to leave an assignment undone.
So, to-do list-making tools might sound like a tiny thing or even unnecessary, but they can get you off the hook.
Password Generator
Whether you are in a corporate company or self-employed, you have a lot of passwords to remember.
You have got passwords for your emails, subscriptions for different platforms and apps, signing into multiple tools, and your devices. It is normal to forget some of them.
But retrieving those passwords is no less than a hassle, which you do not want on a busy day. At the same time, you might immediately need a password to use a certain tool.
So, password generation tools help you to generate a password immediately for a certain tool and save you from generating a new password manually.
Expense Calculator
Every organization must calculate multiple types of expenses, such as budgeting for certain projects, investment costs, VAT calculation, cash flow monitoring, revenue calculation, payroll calculation, and office expenditure.
It is not that easy to calculate all these expenses manually without any mistakes, which can cause big trouble. To make these expense calculations easier and smoother, you can use browser tools like a budget calculator or a monthly expense tracker.
These tools ensure accurate and easy expense calculation, that save from getting into any trouble regarding financial management.
Scheduling
Finally, for scheduling a meeting, event, email delivery, an announcement, or a task automation, you should have a browser-based tool.
Once you set a schedule for a meeting or event on these platforms and tools, they send you notifications on your devices and via email one or two days before the event or meeting.
So these types of browser tools save you from missing anything and give you time to prepare yourself.
Final Thought
By now, you might be thinking that using and handling ten tools on a daily basis will be another reason for wasting time.
But, in reality, when you have to accomplish multiple tasks in one day, these tools will be your life-savers. All you need to do is align your devices with these tools according to their process.
Once you integrate these tools into your workflow, your everyday work life will become a lot easier than you think.

articles.title: En 1987, Brasil inundó una parte de Amazonas del tamaño de Tenerife para una hidroeléctrica. Fue un desastre sin precedentes
articles.text:
En 1981, en plena estrategia brasileña de grandes infraestructuras para desarrollar la Amazonia, comenzaron las obras de la central hidroeléctrica de Balbina sobre el río Uatumã, al norte de Manaos. El embalse empezó a formarse en 1987 y la central fue inaugurada en 1989 con 250 MW de potencia instalada. Para conseguirlos se creó oficialmente un lago de aproximadamente 2.360 km², una superficies grande que la isla de Tenerife.
Una cuestión de tamaños. El problema estaba escrito en la propia geografía: un río relativamente pequeño atravesando un territorio extraordinariamente llano obligaba a inundar cantidades enormes de terreno para conseguir una altura y una producción hidroeléctrica relativamente modestas.
De hecho, un estudio comparativo publicado en 2018 lo resumió con una cifra demoledora: Balbina sacrificó 35 veces más bosque por cada MW de capacidad instalada que la presa amazónica de Tucuruí.
250 MW y un cementerio de árboles. Cuando el Uatumã quedó represado, el agua avanzó lateralmente por la selva y dejó sumergidos millones de árboles. Algunas estimaciones hablan de más de 160 millones. Las antiguas elevaciones quedaron convertidas en miles de islas (un estudio contabilizó 3.546) y aquella fragmentación llegó inicialmente a contemplarse incluso como una posible ventaja ambiental: pedazos de bosque que sobrevivirían rodeados por el embalse.
Ocurrió lo contrario. La investigación posterior constató que muchos de aquellos fragmentos eran demasiado pequeños y estaban demasiado aislados para conservar sus ecosistemas originales, provocando pérdidas progresivas de animales y plantas.
Estampida de especies. La nutria gigante ofrece uno de los ejemplos más contraintuitivos. Después de la inundación, su hábitat acuático potencial alrededor de Balbina se multiplicó por 67 y su población pasó aproximadamente de 140 a 280 individuos, pero los investigadores calcularon que, si aquel nuevo hábitat hubiera funcionado como el antiguo, debería haberse acercado a los 1.250 ejemplares.
La explicación estaba bajo la superficie: Balbina había sustituido ríos de corriente rápida por un gigantesco lago de aguas lentas y había transformado las comunidades de peces. La descomposición inicial del bosque provocó un pulso de nutrientes que favoreció temporalmente a especies como pirañas y tucunarés, pero después disminuyeron los peces migratorios y con ellos parte de las presas disponibles; además, las zonas profundas del embalse presentan aguas pobres en oxígeno donde prácticamente no pueden prosperar los peces.
El bosque desapareció, pero su carbono no. Balbina desmontó también una idea que durante mucho tiempo acompañó a la energía hidroeléctrica: que un embalse, por producir electricidad sin quemar combustibles, era automáticamente una fuente energética limpia. El bosque sumergido y la materia orgánica que llega al reservorio se descomponen y parte de ese carbono acaba regresando a la atmósfera en forma de CO₂ y metano.
Un estudio que midió Balbina durante 2004-2006 calculó para 2005 unas emisiones de CO₂ de 2.450 gigagramos de carbono aguas arriba y otros 81 aguas abajo, incorporando el equivalente de CO₂ de las emisiones de metano estimadas previamente, situó las emisiones totales de gases de efecto invernadero en unos 3 teragramos de carbono al año. Los autores las compararon con aproximadamente la mitad de las emisiones de CO₂ procedentes de la quema de combustibles fósiles de la ciudad de São Paulo.
Gases atravesando turbinas. El funcionamiento de una presa tropical añade un mecanismo menos visible. El agua profunda cargada de gases disueltos entra en las turbinas y, al salir aguas abajo y caer bruscamente la presión, parte de ese CO₂ se libera a la atmósfera. En Balbina, los investigadores calcularon que aproximadamente el 53% del CO₂ que llegaba a las turbinas se desgasificaba inmediatamente a su salida, después siguieron detectando emisiones elevadas a lo largo de los primeros 30 kilómetros del Uatumã.
El estudio describe además un embalse con una profundidad media de solo unos diez metros, aproximadamente un año de tiempo medio de residencia del agua y una productividad energética extraordinariamente baja por superficie inundada: alrededor de 0,14 vatios por metro cuadrado.
El desastre continúa 40 años después. La parte más reciente de la historia obliga a mirar en la dirección contraria al embalse. Un estudio publicado en 2026 en Forest Ecology and Management examinó los bosques inundables de igapó situados aguas abajo y encontró todavía las cicatrices de la alteración provocada cuando se llenó Balbina entre 1987 y 1989.
Al retener el agua, la presa generó una especie de sequía hidrológica artificial en ecosistemas adaptados durante miles de años al pulso regular de inundación del Uatumã: murieron grandes cantidades de árboles y el bosque que posteriormente ocupó las zonas afectadas adquirió una composición diferente. Los investigadores distribuyeron parcelas aproximadamente cada diez kilómetros y encontraron una frontera ecológica alrededor de los 120 km: cerca de la presa dominaban árboles rebrotados y especies asociadas a perturbaciones, mientras las zonas más alejadas conservaban mayor riqueza y especies propias de bosques maduros.
Balbina alteró todo. Ese es probablemente el gran aprendizaje que dejó la presa. Aguas arriba, una inmensa superficie de bosque terrestre se convirtió en lago, fragmentando el paisaje en miles de islas y transformando ecosistemas completos; aguas abajo ocurrió casi lo contrario, porque bosques cuya supervivencia dependía de inundaciones periódicas dejaron de recibir el agua en el momento y durante el tiempo al que estaban adaptados.
Décadas después siguen observándose cambios en diversidad, estructura y biomasa vegetal. Balbina demostró así que la huella ecológica de una presa tropical no puede calcularse simplemente dibujando sobre un mapa el perímetro de su embalse: puede extenderse mucho más allá de él.
La ironía: electricidad de otra manera. En 2016, Balbina apareció como candidato para instalar paneles solares flotantes sobre parte de la superficie que la hidroeléctrica había creado. Se planteó primero una instalación piloto de 5 MW y posteriormente la posibilidad de escalarla hasta unos 300 MW, aprovechando el embalse existente sin ocupar más terreno amazónico. La propuesta encerraba una paradoja difícil de ignorar: utilizar energía solar para sacar mayor rendimiento energético a una enorme superficie artificial que había nacido precisamente de la bajísima eficiencia territorial de la hidroeléctrica.
Era, en cierto modo, intentar que los miles de kilómetros cuadrados inundados décadas antes produjeran finalmente más electricidad sin tener que inundar un solo metro cuadrado adicional.
Construir en el lugar equivocado puede ser un desastre. Porque el problema no fueron simplemente los 250 MW instalados ni podría resumirse simplemente diciendo que Balbina “produce menos que tres aerogeneradores”: tres turbinas offshore convencionales actuales no igualan sus 250 MW de potencia nominal, y comparar capacidad instalada con producción media puede resultar engañoso.
La lección verdaderamente extraordinaria está en la relación entre lo obtenido y lo sacrificado. Una presa levantada sobre un río pequeño y una topografía demasiado plana necesitó inundar unos 2.360 km² de Amazonia, fragmentó el bosque, transformó las comunidades acuáticas, generó importantes emisiones de gases de efecto invernadero y alteró bosques situados hasta 120 kilómetros río abajo.
Casi cuatro décadas de estudios han convertido así a Balbina en algo más útil que un simple fiasco energético: en un gigantesco experimento involuntario que demuestra por qué llamar “renovable” a una fuente de energía nunca basta para saber cuál será su verdadero coste ambiental.
